提名名单是这次发布会另一个重头戏。因为百花奖在这个阶段是大众投票来定，能入围还是很大程度看“观众缘”的，而因为每届要覆盖过去两年，我们可能会看到稍微有些“早”的电影出现——比如本届的评选范围就是 2024 年 3 月 1 日到今年 2 月 28 日期间上映的国产影片（而且观影人次要超过 100 万才有评选资格）。

《南京照相馆》成为这个阶段的大赢家，它入围了 7 个奖，共有 9 个提名（王骁和王传君都入围了“最佳男配角”，王真儿和杨恩又都入围了“最佳女配角”），两个数字都是最多的，但它却没有入围“最佳影片”，这使得名单公布后也有了一些争议的声音（另外《好东西》也没入围“最佳影片”）。

紧随其后的《镖人：风起大漠》和《惊蛰无声》都入围了 6 个奖，各有 7 个提名（刘耀文和陈丽君都入围了“最佳新人”，刘诗诗和杨幂都入围了“最佳女配角”）。《捕风追影》入围了 5 个奖，共 6 个提名（成龙和梁家辉都入围了“最佳男主角”）。

对于一些演员来说，这届百花奖也有里程碑意义，比如这次是梁家辉首次被百花奖提名，同样是首次被提名的还有李云霄和刘诗诗，而朱一龙和马丽都是第二次分别被提名“‌最佳男主角”和“最佳女主角”，他们正是上届百花奖的“影帝”和“影后”。

同样入围“‌最佳男主角”的还有刘昊然和易烊千玺，这是刘昊然第三次入围百花奖，是易烊千玺第五次入围百花奖，两位演员都还不到 30 岁，这个成就已经相当了不起。而上届百花奖获得“最佳新人”的于适这次入围了“最佳男配角”，也是开启了新的征程。

items.title: 提前一年结束合约，科蒂套现 4 亿美元，欧莱雅将在明年拿下 GUCCI 美妆线
items.content_text:
7 月 8 日，Kering 开云集团发布公告，宣布旗下的 GUCCI 已经和欧莱雅集团达成了为期 50 年的独家美妆授权协议，原计划要 2028 年 6 月 30 日 GUCCI 和 Coty 科蒂的协议到期后才开启的合作将提前达成。

开云和欧莱雅集团是去年 10 月 19 日宣布“在高端美容和健康领域建立长期战略合作伙伴关系”的，基于这项合作，开云以 40 亿欧元的价值将旗下美妆业务卖给了欧莱雅集团，随后在今年 4 月 1 日，交易在获得管理机构的批准后正式完成。

其中涉及到的品牌包括了 CREED，以及 Bottega Veneta、Balenciaga 巴黎世家等品牌的美妆产品独家授权许可（都是 50 年合约。除了一笔收购费用，后续每年欧莱雅集团还会向开云支付授权费），也包括 GUCCI。

但 GUCCI 和科蒂的合作已经超过 10 年，科蒂操盘期间 GUCCI 推出了多款热门香水，这反过来让 GUCCI 美妆线成为了科蒂旗下最重要的业务之一，年营收达到 5 - 10 亿欧元，以单一品牌占到科蒂总销售额的约 10%。如果 GUCCI 离开，对于科蒂的业绩无疑会是沉重的打击。

也因此当开云和欧莱雅的合作官宣，科蒂方面一度还在英国提起索赔诉讼，关于科蒂是否能优先续约 GUCCI 的讨论也被放上台面。但科蒂应该也早就想到 GUCCI 是保不住的，开云已经想把 GUCCI 转走了，现有协议到期后其实已经没有谈续约的必要，作为拥有品牌的这一方，开云有的是办法不给你。

现在的结果应该是各方都能接受的最好结果了，开云和欧莱雅直接出钱回购，让 GUCCI 提前一年结束和科蒂的合约，一切顺利的话，2027 年年中 GUCCI 的美妆线就将属于欧莱雅集团。

科蒂因为这个提前一年结束合约将直接得到约 4 亿美元收入，这笔钱由开云和欧莱雅集团一起承担（欧莱雅集团负责 70%），将以现金方式分期支付：今年付 2.5 亿美元，2027 年付 1.5 亿美元。此外交接过程里还涉及到对库存的收购，这部分费用另算，也是欧莱雅集团来付。

这样科蒂就以一笔额外的现金收入提前套现离场。虽然应该不会有再多经营一年赚得多，但这笔钱能在短期降低债务，快速改善公司业绩，也能体面解决和开云的纠葛，同时一并清理库存。既然离开头部奢侈品大牌的未来早晚会来，科蒂可以早为自己打算，去好好深耕自己手上现有的品牌。

对于欧莱雅集团来说，提前一年交割也不只是时间问题，其实是争取了一个更好的机会窗口。提前把竞争对手最核心的现金流资产抽走，将让集团快速站到有利的位置上，这将产生不同的规模效应。同时按现在市场竞争的激烈程度，要的就是尽快抢占年轻消费者的心智，晚一年也许会错过一代消费者也不夸张。

而且其它品牌正在今年陆续并入，过渡调整已经走起来了，如果要等 GUCCI 两年，到时候很多调整和协同还得再走一遍。

既然有机会更早着手打造 GUCCI 美妆，也是更早开启迈向“下一个圣罗兰美妆”的道路，后者在欧莱雅集团的打造下 18 年业绩翻了 5 倍，年销售额达到 30 亿欧元规模，甚至 SAINT LAURENT“主线”都相当乏力了，美妆线还在大步前进，而 GUCCI 的全球影响力比 SAINT LAURENT 高多了，它的美妆线理所应当被承载更高的期望。

开云这边，盘活 GUCCI 主营业务已经是集团当下至关重要乃至生死存亡的目标，尽早“开启 GUCCI 美妆的新篇章”也将有利于 GUCCI 的市场吸引力和品牌价值的巩固与增长。

而值得一提的是，从行业角度，欧莱雅集团拿下 GUCCI 美妆也许会成为全球美妆赛道重构的一个里程碑，从此开云全部头部时装品牌的美妆归了欧莱雅，LVMH 则掌握 DIOR 等自有品牌，科蒂手上的“大牌”还有 Burberry、Chloé、Calvin Klein 这些。照这个态势，未来中小美妆集团也很难再有机会拿到顶流奢侈品牌的长期授权，科蒂此前在做自己品牌的香水了，不管成功与否，寻找新出路都是必须得去做的了。

items.title: 今日消费资讯：星巴克推出 2026 软雪星冰乐系列、KENZO 2026 秋冬系列上市
items.content_text:
《恐怖游轮》内地定档 7 月 17 日

7 月 8 日，《恐怖游轮》（Triangle）定档 7 月 17 日在国内上映，定档海报同步发布。这是这部经典悬疑影片首次登陆内地大银幕。

影片由克里斯托弗·史密斯执导并编剧，2009 年 10 月 16 日在英国首映，它被认为是“无限流”影片的鼻祖。目前它在豆瓣已经有超过 100 万人评分，分数仍然高达 8.5。

《福尔摩斯小姐 3》上线

7 月 1 日，《福尔摩斯小姐 3》（Enola Holmes 3）在 Netflix 上线。

这是《福尔摩斯小姐》系列的续作，不过导演从前两部的哈利·布拉德比尔换成了菲利普·巴兰蒂尼，主演仍然是米莉·波比·布朗饰演伊诺拉·福尔摩斯，亨利·卡维尔饰演夏洛克·福尔摩斯。

星巴克推出 2026 软雪星冰乐系列

7 月 8 日，星巴克中国推出全新升级的软雪星冰乐系列，也迎来这一 2024 年亮相、以意式 Gelato 为灵感的夏季系列的回归。并且这次还是和泡泡玛特旗下 IP MOLLY 一起联动，来共同庆祝 MOLLY 诞生 20 周年。

这次系列有三款口味，其中米芝士软雪星冰乐和可可榛果软雪星冰乐是今年新口味，前者用糯香米粒融合进口马斯卡彭芝士，顶部还撒上了焦糖粉，后者选择了进口 Nutella 榛果可可调味酱，顶部还有摩卡粉和香脆榛子饼干碎，带来多层次口感。此外还有意式开心果软雪星冰乐的回归，它由开心果酱加上开心果饼干碎，带来甜咸交融的味觉体验。

配合这次系列上市，MOLLY 也带来了美人鱼、小画家和小天使三个特别形象，它们出现在了星冰乐杯子以及同步推出的多款联名周边上。同时这次星巴克臻选北京蓝色港湾店进行了专门打造，以“人鱼公主 MOLLY 的软雪世界”为概念化身成了 MOLLY“痛店”，而全国还有超过 150 家 MOLLY 氛围主题店，同学们可以就近打卡。

KENZO 2026 秋冬系列上市

7 月 6 日，由创意总监 NIGO 操刀的 KENZO 2026 秋冬男女系列开始上市，系列全新大片同步发布。大片由 Laura Jane Coulson 掌镜，出演了《后室》的卢基塔·麦克斯韦尔（Lukita Maxwell）和美国艺人 Nico Hiraga 出镜，并在巴黎巴士底街区、品牌创始人高田贤三当年的宅邸拍摄。

随着系列上市，KENZO 也在上海兴业太古汇和深圳湾万象城带来了限时精品店，它们将分别持续到 8 月 31 日和 8 月 15 日，之后位于厦门万象城的限时精品店将在 7 月 16 日亮相，它将持续到 9 月 15 日。

adidas 发布世界杯决赛阶段官方比赛用球

7 月 6 日，adidas 正式发布今年世界杯决赛阶段官方比赛用球：TRIONDA FINAL“三重浪终章”，它将在这次美加墨世界杯的半决赛、铜牌赛及决赛作为官方比赛用球使用。

这是世界杯历史上首次不再用传统配色更新方案，而是引入了专属独立设计。设计上，决赛阶段主办城市以文字排版方式融入进了球面图案，同时它采用与“三重浪”相同的四片式结构、球面形状及表面纹理，从而延续此前比赛一致的体验。

这只足球已经从 7 月 7 日开始通过 adidas 官方商城、官方 app 和指定零售店等渠道发售。

Beats 编织连接线系列推出“超能粉”配色

7 月 7 日，Beats 为编织连接线系列推出了“超能粉”新配色，它仍然采用防缠结的编织设计，并有防磨损的加固处理，使用中兼容了苹果、Android 等各种设备，能支持充电、音频和数据传输、有线 CarPlay 车载等。

它提供了三种规格，1.5 米的 USB-C 转 USB-C 线支持以 60W 功率充电，3 米的 USB-C 转 USB-C 线支持以 240W 功率充电，此外还有 1.5 米 USB-A 转 USB-C 线可选，它们都支持以 USB 2.0 速率传输数据。

目前新配色连接线已经通过苹果官网商店等渠道发售，3 米线是 229 元，1.5 米线定价 145 元。

items.title: 加拿大宜家带来的世界杯主题创意，是用家居产品组成参赛国的国旗
items.content_text:
2026 年美加墨世界杯进入淘汰赛阶段，球场内外的话题越来越多，作为世界第一大运动里的最顶级赛事，世界杯也再次体现了它的全球性和覆盖所有圈层的影响力。

很多品牌都在最近这段时间跟上了世界杯的热点，即便不是官方赞助商，品牌们在创意层面也有的是空间来发挥。像是 IKEA 宜家在加拿大就带来了这段时间的一个主题 Campaign：在世界杯开幕当天，官方陆续分享了一系列国旗图案，后续它们已经在各种渠道传播。

这来自宜家和电通的合作，整个项目主题叫“Assemble the World”（拼出世界）。目前发出的有 12 个世界杯参赛国家的国旗。凑近细看的话，会发现这些国旗其实都是用在宜家能买到的商品给拼出来的，真是奇妙又让人会心一笑。

像是加拿大的国旗是用红色浴巾折出来的，阿根廷国旗是沙发加上章鱼玩偶，日本国旗是白色地毯上放了一张红色凳子……

大家还可以仔细看看其它的组合是怎么来的。

然后官方也分享了里面具体有哪些产品，大家可以买来照着拼（最终还是要落脚到卖货上嘛）。

作为这届世界杯的主办国之一，在加拿大做这个创意还是很应景的，宜家加拿大市场营销总监 Jacqueline Wark 表示加拿大是个包容性很高的多元国家，宜家也希望用这样的策划拉近和世界各地、不同背景的球迷的距离。

而因为宜家加拿大的 slogan 是“Bring Home to Life”（让家焕发生机），传播这次策划时官方来了个“Bring the World to Life”（让世界焕发生机），总之都紧扣了“world”这个关键词（“世界”和“世界杯”的双关）。

这次的策划会在加拿大持续覆盖整个夏季。而换个角度，当下 AI 应用已经非常普遍了，宜家还在用这种非常传统的创意方式并用“手搓”来实现，这本身也令人感慨，希望坚持下去呀。

items.title: 上海乐高乐园开园一周年了，我们从这些数字来看看它这一年的表现
items.content_text:
7 月 5 日，上海乐高乐园度假区在园区入口位置的乐高广场举行活动，庆祝开园一周年。

从 2019 年第二届进博会期间官宣，到 2021 年 11 月 17 日开工，随后在 2025 年 7 月 5 日正式开园（在此之前是 6 月 20 日开启的试运行），上海乐高乐园也算是一步一个脚印、扎扎实实走过来了。

它本身一直就备受关注，也有很多话题（当然也免不了被大家聊到四川乐高乐园的事），但作为中国首座正式亮相的乐高乐园，上海乐高乐园接住了大家的期待，一年下来它为很多同学带来了快乐，也成为了很多家庭上海旅行计划的一部分，即便会看到有吐槽，但那都是相当正常的事情，哪个乐园都避免不了。

重要的是它为更多游客提供了目的地的新选择，同时它本身还保持了持续调整和发展。在这个周岁生日的节点上，我们从 4 个维度、用数字来概括看看过去一年上海乐高乐园都有怎样的表现，取得了哪些成绩。

开业：318000、550000000、85000000

首先是它的规格和级别。开园时的上海乐高乐园占地 31.8 万平方米，是全球开园规模最大的乐高乐园（正在建设中的深圳乐高乐园之后将成为新的全球最大乐高乐园），它的总投资达到 5.5 亿美元，10 多个国家和地区超过 300 个团队、上万名建设者参与了乐园建设。

它为 2 - 12 岁亲子家庭打造（也基本是每个乐高乐园的定位受众），有“乐高乐园创想世界”（LEGO World of Creativity）、“悟空小侠”（Monkie Kid）等 8 个主题区，有超过 75 个互动骑乘设施、表演和玩乐景点，以及超过 33 个餐饮设施、超过 10 个零售商店，还有超过 8500 万块乐高积木拼搭的数千个乐高模型。

其中“乐高乐园创想世界”是作为首发主题区亮相的，而“悟空小侠”也是全球独有的主题区——它也代表了乐高积木和本土文化的持续融合与创新（乐高的“悟空小侠”系列是 2020 年 5 月 15 日发布的，这是乐高品牌首个以中国传统故事为灵感创作的 IP）。

客流：2000000、80%

一年下来，上海乐高乐园接待游客已经超过了 200 万人次，是全球乐高乐园中最快突破 200 万人次客流的。这个客流增速也位居全球乐高乐园同期的首位。

游客当中，亲子家庭还是最核心的客群，占比超过了 80%。同时年卡用户规模“超出预期”。

上海本地和长三角地区还是上海乐高乐园核心的客流来源，不过北京、广东、山东等地增长明显，这些区域的游客占比在逐步提升。

运营：230000、60000

乐园也强调了运营方面的表现，这次提到了开园到现在“门票与二次消费收入趋于平衡”，而复游率也在“持续走高”。

商品方面，上海乐高乐园过去一年累计售出了超过 23 万个乐高人仔，其中约 1/4 是游客在园内自主设计的，它们被作为了纪念品进行收藏。

而对于亲子家庭来说，“砖”属纪念护照也是热门产品，“积木汉堡”、“积木草莓棒冰”等乐高 IP 的特色餐饮产品也是最常被 pick 到的。

另外，过去一年有近 6 万名游客在园内庆祝了生日（过生日是类似的乐园尤其是亲子型主题乐园里一个特别的且含金量很高的指标，“生日客群”无论仪式感、顾客黏性、消费力等都会显著高于普通游客。上海迪士尼那边在最近的 10 周年庆典里也提到了）。

社区：20%、8000、170000

一座乐园对于周围社区乃至更大范围的人群也都会有影响和带动效益。对于上海乐高乐园来说，它一开始就成为了上海金山区标志性的文旅项目，它带动了周边酒店、民宿、餐饮等商业发展，堪称是上海金山区的一张名片。

上海乐高乐园有 20% 的员工就来自金山本地，乐园为当地创造的直接和间接就业机会可见一斑。

同时因为上海乐高乐园的亲子定位，让小朋友能“玩中学”是乐园的一个课题，包括在上海乐高乐园看来，家庭游园方式正在发生变化——从“看孩子游玩”到“与孩子共同参与”，乐园的亲子协作项目、针对孩子更多动手实践的体验，这些正在乐园的运营中逐渐体现。

开园的这一年，8 大创意工坊点位累计举办了超过 8000 场活动，吸引了超过 17 万名游客参与。上海乐高乐园正在将自己打造成“社会-学校-家庭”协同教育的重要场景，而从未来方向上，乐园还将“进一步深化与校园的协作”，推动“科创+研学+乐园”模式的常态化与体系化。

items.title: 每周鞋报：UA 和道奇联名了，Crocs 和超级马力欧的合作系列也很有趣
items.content_text:
前面我们刚报道了 Onitsuka Tiger 鬼冢虎即将重新开启独立运营的消息，这标志着品牌要全面迈向时尚方向，7 月 4 日，鬼冢虎位于上海新天地的全新旗舰店正式开幕了，这一总面积超过 470 平方米的双层空间以时髦且充满辨识度的面貌展现在大家面前。

其中一层以鬼冢虎米兰设计中心带来的 Contemporary 系列为主，这一系列“着重表达品牌审美风格和时尚定位”，同时也有 DENIVITA 丹宁系列和 NIPPON MADE 产品线，二层则打造成了时尚与生活方式的沉浸式空间，展现了鞋履及包袋、配饰在内多元的产品线。

另一边，刚刚首发了 Chuck 70 X 的匡威在东湖路做了跨世“星”生限时体验空间，这个空间已经在 7 月 4 日后结束，当中展示了 Chuck 系列的发展历程、刘知珉（Karina）出镜的大片，也展出了匡威邀请多位艺术家、创意人基于 Chuck 70 X 打造的特别设计。

这一重磅新款会延续老款的经典吗，要等待市场给出的反馈了。

而在一如既往活动集中的上海之外，在线上我们可以关注到的，近期还有这些新鞋履（或者它们所属的新系列）可以留意。

Under Armour X Dodge 联名系列运动休闲鞋

首先是 7 月 3 日 Under Armour 带来了和 Dodge 道奇品牌合作的联名系列，对于美式肌肉车爱好者来说，现在能在国内常规的零售市场上看到道奇，也是很值得珍惜的事情了。而且这次双方合作就是以 Charger SRT Hellcat（地狱猫）和 Challenger SRT Demon（恶魔）两款经典车型为灵感，如果没机会拥有它们，至少可以通过联名系列来表达自己的热爱。

系列带来了多款服饰和鞋履产品，国内上架的有 12 款，包括运动夹克、T 恤、短袖衬衫、工装裤、棒球帽等，它们的设计融入了车型上的线条或经典配色，而这种速度感和力量感不仅来自道奇，也是专注在专业运动上的 UA 所希望传达出的形象。

系列中，国内发售的鞋履有两款，它们都是男女同款，其中 HB-LO 主打黑红配色，强调复古气质，ECHO 采用“一脚蹬”设计搭配可调松紧度系带系统，它的鞋面融入了“地狱猫”图案，虽然主打的大红色会有点考验穿搭，但 ECHO 的脚感相当美好，无论跑步还是日常训练也都非常可靠。

两款鞋定价分别是 999 和 1299 元，它们和整个系列一起已经在 UA 官网和线下门店等渠道发售。

Crocs | 超级马力欧合作系列

同样是联名，Crocs 在 7 月 1 日带来了和任天堂经典 IP 超级马力欧系列合作的全新系列，当中包括了多个鞋款及“智必星”，选择相当的丰富。

设计上，马力欧和伙伴们多个角色都能在鞋上看到，像是马力欧的经典红蓝配色加红色帽子、碧姬公主的柔和粉调与公主气质的“智必星”、耀西的活力绿色以及酷霸的尖刺，大家可以选择自己喜欢的角色，并通过鞋花来进一步的 DIY。

系列带来了成人、儿童和幼童款的经典舒适洞洞鞋，它们分别是 539、469 和 399 元，而马力欧经典洞洞鞋、碧姬公主经典云朵洞洞鞋、耀西经典洞洞鞋和酷霸经典洞洞鞋分别是 599、669、599 和 599 元。

这次“智必星”的选项很多，鞋花五件套是 118 元，无敌星和问号砖块的“智必星”单粒都是 58 元，还有耀西款“智必星”，单粒是 38 元。整个系列会从 7 月 16 日开始通过 Crocs 线下指定门店和天猫官方旗舰店等渠道发售。

PUMA x MondaySleepingClub 联名系列

又一个属于夏日清爽穿搭的联名合作，来自 PUMA 和 MondaySleepingClub，两个品牌在 6 月 23 日推出了全新联名系列。这次设计围绕复古运动造型展开，要兼顾居家的慵懒松弛和夏日户外的优雅质感。

三款薄底鞋成为了系列的核心单品，其中 H-Street 以亮黄色拼接银色跑道条纹，Speedcat 采用深绿色鞋身搭配暖白色，Tackle 则以深棕色拼接暖白皮革鞋面呈现。它们都是复古又精致。

此外系列还有衬衫、T 恤、短裤、裙装、包袋、棒球帽等单品，它们以运动功能融合了学院风，同时搭配了明快的色彩及复古条纹元素，而出现在各个位置的联名专属插画也非常可爱，这是一只猫咪趴在电脑、咖啡杯、闹钟等位置睡觉，真是看着就让人放松和心情好。

adidas“霜紫争锋”套组

世界杯淘汰赛如火如荼，7 月 4 日，adidas 发布了“霜紫争锋”（Chaos vs Control）套组，为仍然在征战世界杯的球员带来了新装备，同时这也是为欧洲新的联赛赛季提前做了准备。

“霜紫争锋”在设计上以霜白为主色调，体现“决战前静谧的战场氛围”，当中主打的是 F50 和 Predator 两款，前者在白底基础上搭配了“风暴紫”的“三道杠”，并点缀了“太阳橙”，亚马尔、登贝莱等球员选择了它，后者点缀的是粉紫色的“三道杠”和灰色暗纹，它会穿在贝林厄姆、佩德里等球员的脚上。

整个套组会从 7 月 8 日开始在 adidas 指定零售店以及官方 app、微信小程序等线上渠道发售。

On Cloudmonster 3 系列新配色、Cloudboom Strike 2 系列、Cloudrunner 3 Max

运动鞋方面，On 昂跑在 7 月 2 日发布了全新跑步理念“Run On Clouds”，要以这个方向持续推动产品研发和创新，同时 On 也一次性更新了多个运动鞋系列，简单直接地让大家当下就能很快拥有，可以直接进入到 On 所要打造的训练节奏当中。

其中 Cloudmonster 3 系列有 Cloudmonster 3、Cloudmonster 3 Hyper 和 LightSpray Cloudmonster 3 Hyper 三个鞋型，这次更新了新配色，它们当下就已经同步通过 On 门店、微信官方商城、天猫官方旗舰店等渠道发售。

Cloudboom Strike 2 系列包括 Cloudboom Strike 2 和 LightSpray Cloudboom Strike 2，系列引入了 CloudTec Sphere，这是 On CloudTec 系统向前迈出的又一步，它通过全新设计的缓冲模块来增强舒适度并优化跑步效率，尤其长距离比赛时会对耐力和速度提供有力支持，同时 Helion 超级泡沫也比第一代减重了 15%，让整双鞋都更轻了。

接下来 Cloudboom Strike 2 会在 7 月 30 日发售，LightSpray Cloudboom Strike 2 会在 10 月上市。

还有 Cloudrunner 3 Max，它基于 Cloudrunner 3 做了升级，以双密度中底结构（上层是 Helion HF 超级泡棉）加后跟 TPU 稳定片来实现舒适的脚感和强劲且稳定的性能，它会在 8 月 6 日发售。

AMI 2027 春夏系列鞋履

6 月 25 日，AMI 在巴黎发布了 2027 春夏系列，创始人兼创意总监 Alexandre Mattiussi 兼顾了对经典男装剪裁的探索和对属于现代多元的率性时髦，整个系列都有着特别的混搭美学，并且设计上跳出了传统廓形，以柔和的线条、宽松版型、半衬或完全无衬里等设计营造出流动的效果。

系列用了府绸、真丝、羊毛等材质，色彩上以中性色调为底，同时点缀了宝石红、赭黄、钴蓝等亮色，而工装风、复古水洗、图案印花等元素也都用上了，帮助大家进行层叠造型，再加上强调触感且低调奢华的 Boyfriend 和 Bingo 等手袋，它们会在长时间使用下更加柔和优美。

鞋履部分，本季有全新复古学院风运动鞋和重新演绎的 Mirage 幻影运动鞋，还有注塑橡胶便鞋和带有错视效果的系带鞋。届时上市后，我们可以有很多的选择，不同风格的穿着也都可以直接搭配。

items.title: ICICLE 之禾的品牌书来到第 4 卷了，以纸质承载价值叙事还在继续 #每周一书
items.content_text:
各家品牌的出版物里，ICICLE 之禾的可能算是比较年轻的一本，ICICLE 之禾的品牌书从 2024 年 9 月开始，到今年一共出了 4 本，基本形成了春夏季和秋冬季各一本的节奏，也跟随了每年两次产品系列发布的大节点。

周期也是按照时尚行业的常规跨度，书的组稿、编辑基本是在品牌大秀阶段开始进行，然后书的发布和这一季产品上市同期，这样书也成为产品展示与理念传达的重要载体之一。在之前我们看过《ICICLE 之禾·02 卷》后，去年 9 月和今年 3 月，我们又先后收到了《ICICLE 之禾·03 卷》和《ICICLE 之禾·04 卷》。

《ICICLE 之禾·03 卷》的一个背景是去年 3 月 ICICLE 之禾首次在巴黎时装周做了秀，带来了 2025 秋冬工坊系列，这是品牌首次登上巴黎时装周的官方日程。品牌 2012 年就设立了巴黎设计中心（当时 ICICLE 之禾在巴黎的首位员工就是现在的创意总监 Bénédicte Laloux），到终于做了正式官方走秀，也是个里程碑了。

也因此，《ICICLE 之禾·03 卷》中分享了首次参加巴黎时装周的故事，Bénédicte Laloux 也带来了自己的感悟和思考，她介绍了一些重点产品，并强调了“家”这个关键词，无论是家人还是 ICICLE 工坊是她工作上的“家”，这一概念传递出的实用与美、真诚与安定，也都体现在了当季的产品上。

ICICLE 之禾 2025 秋冬工坊系列本身的主题就是“从家出发”，这本书也自然将“家”作为了主线，14 位全球摄影师带来了创作，文字部分有中国媒体人曹丹、法国时尚记者 Natasha Fraser-Cavassoni、时装评论家 Sophie Fontanel 等参与。除了 lookbook，书里也带来了从巴黎到上海的建筑、艺术与美食。“家”不一定是空间名词，也是一种感受和体会。

到了今年 3 月，《ICICLE 之禾·04 卷》讲述的就是品牌的 2026 春夏系列的故事了，去年 9 月品牌在 2026 春夏巴黎时装周带来了全新的工坊系列，在书里也将完整的 2026 春夏系列作了呈现。

这次有 13 位摄影师参与，法国文化记者 Fabrice Gaignault、哲学家 Emanuele Coccia、中英混血美食作家 Michael Zee、英国建筑师与策展人 Stefano Rabolli Pansera 分享了自己在不同领域的见解，此外书里也继续带来了 ICICLE 中法文化展览项目，当中介绍了 4 位新的合作艺术家。

今年秋天，ICICLE 之禾还会在杭州开出全新的旗舰综合体“之禾卡纷山水”，这会延续上海“之禾卡纷花园”的理念，融合精品店及咖啡馆、餐厅、画廊和书店等多种业态。《ICICLE 之禾·04 卷》里采访了操刀空间设计的尚壹扬设计工作室的支鸿鑫，也是提前为新店做了预热。

而整体来说，仍然以严肃的态度和这么厚实的内容来做纸质刊物，这样的品牌本身也不多了，ICICLE 之禾仍然选择用这种方式来承载价值叙事，非常的“慢”且长期主义，这除了是一种呈现和价值观的传递，是品牌气质的组成部分，其实也是对受众人群的一种筛选。

并且书的质感好到还是让人很愿意收藏的，它会在品牌的线下精品店铺以及合作文化空间里呈现，有机会碰到的同学可以翻翻看看。

items.title: 有动作有剧情，今年上半年看的新剧里，有这 6 部可以推荐给大家
items.content_text:
今年上半年有哪些电影或者剧集给你留下了深刻印象？《给阿嬷的情书》、《寒战 1994》这些都算是国民话题了，而除此之外，不同口味的同学们的选择就走向了不同方向，然后又有《铁拳教育》让大家在社交平台上又沸腾了一把。

带来过去半年我自己看过的剧集里觉得可以推荐的 6 部，它们基本都在半年内上线或开播，同时剧情相对完整（像《猎犬》第二季需要看过第一季才能理解，但第一季又特难看，或者像《九条的大罪》结尾直接成了第二季的预告，这些就不推荐了），属于是我很高兴能看过这些剧的那种。

同时也还是稍微考虑了大众口味，比如《将棋女王》完全是因为想看能年玲奈，而《冬日的什么呀，春日的什么呢》我自己看着很舒服，但太挑观众了……但无论如何，这仍然是一份充满了主观偏见的剧集清单，给大家一个参考和查漏补缺吧（大家如果有推荐，也欢迎评论区见）。

《铁拳教育》

上线时间：2026 年 6 月 5 日
着重看的：又是洪忠灿加金武烈加李星民、今年上半年现象级韩剧、从剧里影响到现实世界

这应该是今年上半年绕不过去的热门剧了，而且它完全是凭借着内容在上线后实现的大范围传播（甚至从宣布要拍到上线前，它因为原作存在争议而不被看好，甚至原定男主金南佶也因此辞演）：它上线 3 天就拿下 Netflix 全球非英语剧集榜单第一，并在 46 个国家和地区拿下 Netflix 收视冠军，成为了新的现象级韩剧。

Netflix 和洪忠灿的改编淡化了原作漫画里的争议内容，而将着眼点放在了教师权益、校园霸凌和教育制度改革等议题上，这也是又一次的洪忠灿加金武烈加李星民的组合，让人想到之前的《少年法庭》。

而《铁拳教育》里有爽剧的部分，但更重要的是它的现实意义，它的很多内容融合了韩国近年来一些真实的社会事件，有众多老师反映剧中的校园困境具有现实基础（与此同时韩国也有多个教师协会发布声明表示剧集带有“美化私刑暴力”等问题），甚至韩国部分地方政府正在考虑将剧中虚拟的“教权保护局”落到现实，以更有力地介入校园霸凌等问题。

影视内容影响到现实世界，在韩国也不是第一次了，事情也许会往更好的方向变化一点点。而至于《铁拳教育》会不会有第二季，目前 Netflix 并没宣布，但洪忠灿在接受采访时表示了对继续拍的期待，他认为“教权保护局”的故事还有更多可以展开的内容。

《暗影蜘蛛侠》

上线时间：2026 年 5 月 27 日
着重看的：尼古拉斯·凯奇、超级英雄、2026 年的黑白剧集

一部很特别的剧集，说是超级英雄剧吧，看完大家可能都不太会往那方面想，说是有种给接下来《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》上映预热的效果吧，一般我们也很难把尼古拉斯·凯奇跟蜘蛛侠这个角色联系起来。

不过尼古拉斯·凯奇的确在《蜘蛛侠：平行宇宙》中为“暗影蜘蛛侠”（Spider-Noir）这个角色配了音，最终他本人出演了真人剧集，亲自当上了蜘蛛侠，也算是水到渠成，无论是这个形象还是我看剧的体验，都是有种奇妙、冲突又和谐的感觉。

《暗影蜘蛛侠》设定在上世纪 30 年代的美国大萧条时期，拍摄方式与最终画面也遵循了当时的质感和风格，整部剧是用黑白摄影机拍摄的，但又为了兼顾当下大家的观影习惯也专门上色做了彩色版，因此这部剧有黑白和彩色两种版本可以选着看（从经验来说，但凡有黑白版都可以无脑优先选，毕竟没点东西谁敢做黑白的）。

这部剧仍然属于“索尼影业蜘蛛侠宇宙”，但以索尼影业现在对这一块的投资力度（尤其在《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》已经回归漫威电影宇宙后），以及之前那些《莫比亚斯》、《猎人克莱文》、《蜘蛛夫人》等都堪称一团糟的情况下，未来“暗影蜘蛛侠”这个角色会走向何方也很难讲。《暗影蜘蛛侠》甚至是索尼这边评分和反响最好的真人内容之一了。

以及不得不提一下尼古拉斯·凯奇的演技，虽然有种老了之后干什么都心酸的感觉（或者是他成功地传递出了这种感觉），但很大程度上也是靠他把这个其实是有点单薄的剧情给撑起来的。

《夜魔侠：重生》第二季

上线时间：2026 年 3 月 24 日
着重看的：超级英雄、惩罚者等多个“老角色”联动、黑暗元素

说到今年上半年正经的超级英雄剧，最热门的应该还是《黑袍纠察队》第五季，毕竟是最终季，而且“出道即巅峰”，到现在大家还是会有特别的期待，但……第五季就是一直看《黑袍纠察队》和《V 世代》的同学肯定要看的，但也不用刻意推荐了（其实我自己觉得还行，没有社交平台上吐槽的那么严重）。

倒是《夜魔侠：重生》第二季值得专门提。整个剧从头到尾营造出了特别好的氛围，紧凑、有内容，如果说第一季还有磨合的痕迹，第二季就完全走起来了，很多时候那种黑暗与绝望感甚至让我想到 DC 那边《小丑》等几部经典的电影和剧，在迪士尼的框架下，这已经做得相当好了。

同时这部剧也在承上启下，当中惩罚者、杰西卡·琼斯都出现了，卢克·凯奇和“铁拳”的回归也是时间问题（这都时隔多少年了，“捍卫者联盟”又要回来了），以及剧里还塑造了一个特别成功的“靶眼”，他也会在后续的漫威宇宙内容里成为“重要的边缘角色”。

也老有人把“比不上 Netflix 时期”挂在嘴上，其实此一时彼一时，谁都不否认 Netflix 时期《夜魔侠》的经典，但大家都要往前走的，夜魔侠的故事还在继续讲（也基本确定会和惩罚者一起出现在《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》里了）本身就很了不起了，现在漫威乃至整个超级英雄影视内容都很疲软，《夜魔侠：重生》第二季豆瓣评分能有 8.3，可见一斑。

《一点点超能力》

首播时间：2025 年 10 月 21 日
着重看的：宫崎葵啊冈田将生啊、可爱又轻巧的日剧

每年都会有些特别轻巧、天马行空、可爱又超脱的日剧冒出来，像之前的《热点》和《幸福伽菜子的快乐杀手生活》这些。去年底播出并上线（几乎同时在电视台和 Netflix 开播）的《一点点超能力》也是类似的，我在今年看了，也挺开心。

剧集的设定是每个人都有一点点的超能力，但最后却指向了拯救世界的大事件。其实吧……剧情内容也是相当经不起推敲的，而且原本可以是个特别宏大的世界观，最终却拍得特别“小”，大概也是这类日剧的风格。

而剩下的就是各种小趣味小温馨了，尤其还有宫崎葵啊冈田将生啊这些人，他们出现本身就挺让人开心的。

感觉上这部剧似乎和同样在去年上线的韩剧《现金英雄》有点类似，不过日剧韩剧的风格在这两部剧上就很明显体现出来了，只是设定有点像，讲故事的方式、过程和收尾差别都挺大的。

《哥本哈根测试》

上线时间：2025 年 12 月 27 日
着重看的：情节紧凑流畅、刘思慕

今年我真正看完的第一部剧是去年底上线的《哥本哈根测试》（真就在元旦节当天一口气追完的），这部温子仁监制、刘思慕主演（刘思慕也是制片人之一）的剧我一度以为它后面会爆火，结果并没有，但不影响我对它的评价。

就是很好看，从剧情到演员表现都很过关，虽然这个“自己大脑被入侵，对方能看到和听到自己感知的一切”的设定给人感觉可能很复杂、有门槛，但实际看起来其实非常流畅，紧凑又悬疑，设置的悬念、该有的反转都给到位了，看完只想催个第二季。

但据 Variety 4 月 25 日报道，Peacock 已经取消了这部剧，它不会再有第二季。虽然它获得了（看过的人）普遍的好评，业内评价也都很高，但观众规模一直就没起来（总有些电影和剧是这样。豆瓣这边也是，目前只有 2000 多人“看过”）。

反正就当个限定剧看也行，剧情本身也是完整的，刘思慕也真配得上更大的舞台了。其实《哥本哈根测试》里刘思慕这个也是欧美影视内容里少见的正面且大主角的华裔角色了（明确设定就是中国来的），后来看了央视电影频道融媒体中心对刘思慕的采访，也对他的成长和经历有了更多的感触（刘思慕本身就一直在为亚裔发声，是个很敢说话的演员）。

《武士生死斗》

上线时间：2025 年 11 月 13 日
着重看的：阵容强大、各种爆款元素集合、武士打斗场面很过瘾

《武士生死斗》是又一部我以为它会火的——至少它会给人一种 Netflix 是奔着把它打造成爆款去的感觉，而它已经确定续订了第二季，可以放心追起来。

剧集改编自今村翔吾的同名长篇小说，Netflix 的打造让剧集有了各种爆款元素：一群武士要互相战斗，要争夺奖金，很像明治时期版本的《鱿鱼游戏》、《大逃杀》或者《饥饿游戏》。而且故事要在一段旅程中展开，还有大叔保护小女孩的桥段，一路上升级打怪组建团队，各种元素都齐了。

《武士生死斗》里塑造了多个充满记忆点的角色，同时打斗场面非常过瘾，甚至还切入了一下真实的历史（比如剧里也有刺杀大久保利通）。想想最后一部《浪客剑心》真人版电影已经过去 5 年了，《武士生死斗》保持了武士打斗的动作水准，也多少承接了一下大家的情怀。

items.title: 时隔近 50 年，鬼塚虎即将重新开启独立运营，但它并没有和 ASICS 分家
items.content_text:
6 月 10 日，ASICS 亚瑟士公司（ASICS Corporation）发布公告，宣布将分拆出 Onitsuka Tiger 鬼塚虎品牌，后者会由全新的子公司 OT GROUP（OT GROUP Corporation。也就是鬼塚虎名字的首字母）接管，并计划在 2027 年 1 月 1 日正式生效。

届时除了集团下的业务，鬼塚虎在各个国家和地区的所有实体都将从 ASICS 公司或子公司剥离，并全部重组到 OT GROUP 旗下，OT GROUP 将成为鬼塚虎的运营公司，它将开始负责鬼塚虎的生产、销售等所有环节。

不过这并不代表 ASICS 要和鬼塚虎分家，因为 OT GROUP 就是 ASICS 的全资子公司，ASICS 是 OT GROUP 的唯一股东，100% 持股。公司没有出售股权或者引入新的投资者，也没有计划上市。鬼塚虎还是完全属于 ASICS 的。

在公告中，ASICS 表示分拆鬼塚虎的目的是为了加速后者的发展，要以“更加独立的运营结构”来“加快决策速度，增强品牌竞争力”，同时反过来也推动 ASICS 公司自身“提升各业务板块的业绩透明度，并明确管理层责任”，从而实现公司整体“可持续的业务增长”。

可以说公司是对鬼塚虎有了更高的预期，这次分拆更准确地说是对鬼塚虎的一次松绑了。

鬼塚虎在 1949 年由鬼塚喜八郎创立，当时公司名叫鬼塚株式会社（Onitsuka Co.），1966 年公司推出了迄今最重要的鞋款 Mexico 66，这是鬼塚虎当时赞助日本队出战 1968 年墨西哥奥运会而专门打造的，也是“虎爪纹”的首次搭载。

今年已经是 Mexico 66 诞生的 60 周年，这仍然是大家在买鬼塚虎时可能首先想到的鞋款（不过它在发布的当时并没有这么火，而是在 1978 年被李小龙的电影《死亡游戏》给带火的）。

随后在 1977 年，在合并了 GTO 和 Jelenk 后，要侧重向运动领域发展的公司整合成 ASICS，鬼塚虎成为了新公司下的支线品牌。随后鬼塚虎进入沉寂期，直到 2002 年左右正式回归，成为了复古风潮的代表（2003 年的《杀死比尔》则直接把鬼塚虎带上话题顶峰）。

如果按 1977 年整合进集团公司来算，这也是时隔近 50 年后，鬼塚虎重新回到了独立身份。即便品牌资产、供应链等环节肯定还是和 ASICS 深度绑定的，但现在鬼塚虎有了自主运营的决策权，包括公司地址也隔开了，ASICS 总部还是在鬼塚虎最初诞生的神户，而 OT GROUP 将总部放在了东京（从 2011 年就开始负责鬼塚虎全球业务的 Ryoji Shoda 则直接出任了 OT GROUP 的总裁兼 CEO）。

而同时如果看公告内容，这次分拆还有一个重点，是鬼塚虎要推进独立直营店的扩张，并且发展方向是要做成“奢侈生活方式品牌”（luxury lifestyle brand），这将和仍然作为体育用品公司的 ASICS 做出区隔。

按目前鬼塚虎的产品布局以及大家对品牌的认知了解，鬼塚虎的确已经离专业运动场景有些远了，大家选择鬼塚虎肯定是为了时尚潮流穿搭而进行穿着（包括这两年鬼塚虎开出的门店也有着鲜明的个性，并和 ASICS 相对传统的门店有很明显的不同），这次分拆其实也是顺理成章。

这背后，无论是 ASICS 公司还是鬼塚虎品牌，漂亮的业绩也支持了公司做接下来的调整。按今年 5 月 13 日 ASICS 发布的 2026 财年一季度财报（截止到今年 3 月 31 日），本季公司净销售额 2702 亿日元，同比增长 29.7%，净利润 465 亿日元，同比增长 47.2%，并且所有品类和地区市场销售额都在增长，其中鬼塚虎的净销售额同比增长也达到了 33.8%。

而在 2025 财年全年，ASICS 8109 亿日元的净销售额同比增长也达到 19.5%，1425 亿日元的营业利润和 987 亿日元的净利润同比更是分别大涨 42.4% 和 54.7%。单看鬼塚虎的话，2025 财年它拿下 1365 亿日元的净销售额，同比增长约 43%，是 ASICS 公司下增长最快且盈利能力最强的业务板块。

尤其以当下并不算好的大环境来说，ASICS 和鬼塚虎的势头都相当可观，而现在它们一个要减负且专注、一个要以更灵活的姿态迈向新目标，未来它们的发展真是让人非常期待。

items.title: 今日消费资讯：蔡依林出任兰蔻亚太区护肤代言人、Damiani 集团完成对名士的收购
items.content_text:
蔡依林出任兰蔻亚太区护肤代言人

7 月 3 日，兰蔻宣布蔡依林成为兰蔻亚太区护肤代言人。

Louis Vuitton 古龙水“太阳之歌”焕新发布

7 月 3 日，Louis Vuitton 路易威登推出古龙水系列“太阳之歌”（Sun Song）的焕新版本，这是基于 2019 年的“初代”产品对包装进行了全新设计，在 Marc Newson 定义的香水瓶身的基础上，多媒体艺术家 Alex Israel 将瓶身颜色从原来的黄色升级为亮黄色到暖橙色的渐变效果，这会更有太阳的感觉。

同步亮相的还有旅行装香水盒，它采用通透的有机玻璃材质，上面装饰了经典 Monogram 图案，整体也采用了和香水瓶身呼应的暖橙渐变色调。

7 月 4 日开始它们会通过 LV 官网、线下专卖店等渠道发售，“太阳之歌”古龙水定价 2600 元（100ml），旅行装香水盒 9750 元。

江诗丹顿南京德基广场精品店焕新开幕

7 月 2 日，江诗丹顿南京德基广场精品店焕新开幕，店铺展现了极简理念与品牌的当代美学风格，有品牌标志性“马耳他十字”元素的应用，也有材料和光影的组合。

店内以三座独立展示柜呈现了江诗的丹顿目前各个系列的产品，有“精研制表展示区”展现时计诞生过程的工艺之美，也有开放式“个性定制区”在提供专属服务同时，也方便顾客进行产品鉴赏。

这次店铺重装焕新也在进一步完善品牌在华东地区的商业布局，也展现了江诗丹顿持续深耕中国市场的决心。

Damiani 集团完成对名士的收购

7 月 1 日，Damiani 集团宣布从历峰集团收购名士（Baume & Mercier）100% 股权的交易已经在相关先决条件达成后正式完成交割。

历峰集团和 Damiani 集团是今年 1 月 22 日宣布了收购交易，而随着 Damiani 集团收购名士正式完成，集团计划将基于名士在意大利市场奠定的基础，要在全球重点市场稳步推进名士单一品牌精品店布局。

这次交易的财务条款并未披露。在 Damiani 集团将名士整合至自身运营体系的过渡期内，历峰集团还将继续为名士提供运营服务。

Swatch 发售 WHAT IF…JELLY? 系列

7 月 2 日，Swatch 开始在全球渠道发售 WHAT IF…JELLY? 系列，这是 WHAT IF? 系列的新成员，它们延续了 33 x 33 毫米方形表盘设计，由生物源材质打造，并以鲜艳色彩搭配透明元素呈现。

苹果推送 3 大系统版本更新

6 月 30 日，苹果推送了 iOS 26.5.2、iPadOS 26.5.2 和 macOS 26.5.2 系统版本更新，这次主要是进行安全修复。

items.title: 实验室带你过周末：2026.7.4 - 7.5 成都篇
items.content_text:
人在成都的同学们，2026 年已经过去一半，感觉又离跨年不远了，上半年的目标都完成了吗？

本周成都尼依格罗酒店开启了和 EviDenS de Beauté 伊菲丹的联动，双方带来了联名限定的“以爱之名”下午茶及主题套房，它们将在接下来两个月时间里提供，其中也覆盖了今年的七夕，这样也给大家表达对另一半的关心与爱意提供了新的选择，就和伊菲丹的诞生是因为创始人 Charles-Edouard Barthes 想要守护亚裔敏感肌妻子一样。

在此之前伊菲丹超级面膜就已经是社交平台上的热门单品，这次的合作也延续了伊菲丹的品牌理念，以及包括视觉在内大家熟悉的各种元素，酒店饼房厨师长张婷婷带领团队打造了多款精致茶点，其中柠檬奶油柚子巧克力慕斯呼应了伊菲丹超级面膜瓶身的线条，菠萝香缇斑斓叶啫喱马卡龙和薄荷奶冻玫瑰芝士蛋糕则以爱心、玫瑰等造型表达了浪漫与爱的主题。

目前下午茶已经开始提供，都是双人的，也有香槟鱼子酱版本可选，而且享用下午茶还能获得价值 530 元的伊菲丹超级 CP 小美盒一份，会显得非常划算超值。

同时双方也将体验延伸到了入住礼遇上，这次成都尼依格罗酒店以 N3 尊贵豪华寺景大床房和 Explorer Suite 探索者套房两种房型为宾客打造了沉浸式体验，除了房间内各种品牌元素的装点，入住大床房会得到价值 960 元的伊菲丹“以爱之名”小美盒，入住套房更是能得到价值 2260 元的伊菲丹全明星套组小美盒。

无论是外地的同学来成都出差或休假，还是成都的大家来一次城市微旅行，这都不要错过了。

成都尼依格罗酒店 x 伊菲丹“以爱之名”下午茶
时间：7 月 1 日 - 8 月 31 日每天 13:00 - 18:00
地点：锦江区红星路三段 1 号成都 IFS 3 号楼成都尼依格罗酒店 3F 悦廊
费用：498 / 788 元（双人下午茶 / 双人香槟鱼子酱下午茶）
电话：028-82208888

成都尼依格罗酒店 x 伊菲丹主题套房
时间：7 月 1 日 - 8 月 31 日
地点：锦江区红星路三段 1 号成都 IFS 3 号楼成都尼依格罗酒店

在太古里的东广场，New Balance 在 6 月底带来了“百年匠心·质感之旅”限时特展的成都站，活动会持续到 7 月 5 日结束，这个周末是最后的打卡机会。

活动是 New Balance 品牌 120 周年纪念策划的一部分（New Balance 在 1906 年创立），遵循着“五行”叙事，在上海站的“金”篇章之后，成都站以“木”作为了主题，整个空间强调了竹子这一核心意象，无论外部的三组屏风还是内部的装置，竹编元素都整体贯穿，也串联起了品牌的百年发展以及与城市文化的联结。

空间内有多个区域，其中“风格鞋履”展区带来了 ABZORB 1890A、ABZORB 1890 等目前的主打款，它们都延续了 ABZORB 缓震家族标志性的舒适脚感，而中央的“匠心共振”互动装置则以竹编动态起伏的结构具象化地演绎了 ABZORB 的回弹和承托性能，同时大家还可以在“匠作工台”核心体验区来亲手进行竹编的体验。

这些环节都加入了打卡机制，在集齐三枚印章后，大家就可以到太古里的 NB Grey R 门店兑换限量礼物，以更多的方式来分享品牌生日的快乐。

New Balance“百年匠心·质感之旅”限时特展成都站
时间：6 月 26 日 - 7 月 5 日
地点：锦江区中纱帽街 8 号成都太古里东广场
费用：免费

对于成都的咖啡爱好者们来说，常识咖啡一定是个会经常被提起的名字，6 月初，常识在 in99 开出了新店，这是常识的第 7 家门店。还在稳扎稳打的拓店，真是很厉害。

新店面朝 ing 巷，在华尔道夫酒店正大门旁边不远。虽然背靠一个热闹的商场，但又在相对安静的位置，也是很有常识风格的选址了。

而这其实是个完全的户外店，没有室内空间（室内的部分全部用来负责点单和咖啡出品了），点上咖啡后大家可以在露天里放松放松，和朋友聊聊天，坐店铺的桌椅可以，在花园里找个地方随便坐也行。

话说今年成都天气不太热（成渝两地好像都没热起来，往年 7 月怎么会才 20 度多一点），即便坐户外也仍然很舒服。

常识咖啡 common sense（in99 店）
时间：每天 8:00 - 19:30
地点：高新区天府大道北段 1199 号成都华尔道夫酒店旁 30 米

items.title: 今日消费资讯：TOP 登陆少年成为 Prada 品牌大使、KENZO 发布 2027 春夏系列
items.content_text:
《喜剧之王单口季》第三季定档 7 月 3 日

6 月 30 日，《喜剧之王单口季》第三季宣布回归，节目将从 7 月 3 日开始在爱奇艺上线，每周五、周六 12 点爱奇艺会员抢先看一周。

本季主持人仍然是庞博，气氛组组长包括了郭麒麟、黄渤和马思纯，喜单老友有付航、李雪琴、王建国和小鹿。

成都东郊记忆举行“东方正火 5 周年大赏”

6 月 30 日，成都东郊记忆举行“东方正火 5 周年大赏”，庆祝东方正火在 2021 年接手运营东郊记忆并启动提档升级的 5 周年。

活动在全天带来了分时段多元特色内容，在日间开放了“东方正火主理人商学院”实景工作坊和“东市·潮人节”系列活动，前者有 12 家园区标杆品牌在自有门店开设专属实战课堂，涵盖了潮流、服饰、宠物、烘焙等多元赛道，并由一线主理人来分享真实案例，推动孵化本土原创商业力量，后者则融合了音乐下午茶、潮流互动盲盒、市民素人走秀以及戏剧秀等活动，让整个空间成为城市文化客厅。

在晚间，行业专家、园区主理人、商户代表汇集到大戏台茶馆，在圆桌对谈《做东开摆》上分享城市更新、文商旅运营、文创产业、非标实体创业等话题，活动上还同步完成了东方正火主理人商学院的揭牌仪式，12 位标杆主理人依次登台领取授牌，标志着园区实景创业实训平台全面启动。

东方正火也分享了东郊记忆新的阶段性运营成果和空间升级规划：2026 年的前 5 个月，园区迎来 83 家特色品牌全新入驻，丰富了潮流零售、音乐演艺、宠物休闲等多元业态，而 MASONPRINCE、PUMA、TOPTOY 等品牌也即将落地。同时园区“五街、一仓、一巷、一心”全域体系都进行了焕新，将构建分层有序、业态互补的完整消费生态。

TOP 登陆少年成为 Prada 品牌大使

6 月 30 日，Prada 宣布 TOP 登陆少年组合（TransfOrm Project）成为 Prada 品牌大使。

奥玛·希成为积家品牌挚友

6 月 30 日，积家宣布奥玛·希（Omar Sy）成为品牌挚友。

KENZO 发布 2027 春夏系列

6 月 25 日，KENZO 在巴黎胜利广场带来 2027 春夏系列，这里是高田贤三 1976 年开设首家精品店的位置，这次 NIGO 也以全新系列致敬了品牌创立之初时到今天“始终不曾褪色的乐观与鲜活”。

本季 NIGO 继续从品牌经典档案中汲取创作灵感，他为系列带来了运动休闲与浪漫、复古廓形与全新创意等多层次、多元化的碰撞，并在穿搭风格上体现出松弛、洒脱与随性。其中能看到常春藤学院风格和运动单品，花卉纹样、缎带元素等为系列加入了更多浪漫气息，此外日式丹宁牛仔、工装风格也通过不同的剪裁融入在了设计里。

配饰方面，有 Victoire 手袋复刻了档案库里的经典邮差包型，Kite 风筝系列包袋多了新色，印花枕头包则复刻了复古插画纹样。同时本季 KENZO 也和匡威合作带来了新的联名系列，有 Chuck 70 和低帮 Jack Purcell“开口笑”为原型进行全新呈现，另外还有和法国百年制鞋工坊 Paraboot 的首次联动，双方重塑了 Michael 皮鞋等鞋型。

items.title: 第 37 届台湾金曲奖揭晓，A-Lin 主持备受好评，蔡依林和张震岳成为大赢家
items.content_text:
6 月 27 日晚 7 点，第 37 届台湾金曲奖颁奖典礼在台北小巨蛋举行，A-Lin 如愿担任了颁奖典礼主持人（这还是她首次主持大型典礼，反响还特别好，明年应该也是她了吧），今年的获奖名单正式揭晓。

在此之前，这届台湾金曲奖的主视觉是 4 月 29 日亮相的，入围名单则在 5 月 13 日公布，提名环节蔡依林的《Pleasure》入围 9 项领跑，排第二的是裘德的《离开银色荒原》，有 7 项入围，张震岳的《跟着感觉走》入围 6 项排第三。

这届台湾金曲奖有一个变化——或者说新规定，是关于 AI 的。官方确认创作者在创作过程中可以将生成式 AI 作为辅助工具，但如果某个环节全部由 AI 生成，那么这部分不能参与相应奖项的评选。比如用 AI 生成歌词就不能报“最佳作词人奖”，用 AI 生成旋律就不能报“最佳作曲人奖”。

听起来很合理，其实就是明确了只有人类创作才有资格被提名或获奖，也和国际上已有的新规一致（比如格莱美奖早在 2023 年 6 月就更新了关于 AI 的条款，明确了奖项只会颁给人类创作者），同时也并没有禁止 AI 参与音乐创作（当然就算禁止也没用）。

这个结论是没有问题，几乎也是现阶段最好的选择了，但毕竟要作为规定来公布和执行，仍然是件大事，有着里程碑式的意义。

第 37 届台湾金曲奖完整获奖名单

年度专辑奖：蔡依林《Pleasure》
年度歌曲奖：A-Lin《幸福在歌唱》
最佳华语专辑奖：张震岳《跟着感觉走》
最佳台语专辑奖：萧煌奇《做一个惜情软心的人》
最佳客语专辑奖：黄宇寒《Ngai》
最佳原住民语专辑奖：漂流出口《Masonolay i Cepo'》

最佳作曲人奖：张震岳（张震岳《浪人的…》/《跟着感觉走》）
最佳作词人奖：小寒（彭佳慧《成人之美》/《完整的大人》）
最佳编曲人奖：裘德、崔展鸿（裘德《银色荒原》/《离开银色荒原》）
最佳专辑制作人奖：常石磊（单依纯《纯妹妹》）
最佳单曲制作人奖：ØZI、鹤 The Crane（ØZI、Gummy B、鹤 The Crane《FINAL FINAL FINAL》/《SWIRL》）

最佳华语男歌手奖：张震岳（《跟着感觉走》）
最佳华语女歌手奖：蔡依林（《Pleasure》）
最佳台语男歌手奖：萧煌奇（《做一个惜情软心的人》）
最佳台语女歌手奖：PiA 吴蓓雅（《离婚初体验》）
最佳客语歌手奖：陈以诺（《慢花志》）
最佳原住民语歌手奖：Suming 舒米恩（《Mikerid 引路》）
最佳乐团奖：落日飞车（《QUIT QUIETLY》）
最佳演唱组合奖：GENBLUE 幻蓝小熊（《MIRROR》）
最佳新人奖：陈娴静（《如果每天都可以 happy happy 谁想要 sad： *-合作的秘密》）

演奏类最佳专辑奖：苏郁涵《OVER the MOONs》
演奏类最佳专辑制作人奖：黄瑞丰、吴政君（《传奇，双击——新视界》）
演奏类最佳作曲人奖：苏郁涵（《Pieces Peace 碎碎平安》/《OVER the MOONs》）

技术类最佳 MV 奖：icyball 冰球乐团《Dumplings》
技术类最佳演唱录音专辑奖：蔡依林《Pleasure》
技术类最佳演奏录音专辑奖：陶玙《I Am Here》
技术类最佳装帧设计奖：吴建龙、亚历三小、蔡伟群（SAX MACHINE《SAX TAPE》）

评审团奖：陈小霞（《老翅膀》）
特别贡献奖：屠颖、林煌坤

相比去年台湾金曲奖饱受质疑（比如《星期五晚上》的“年度歌曲奖”），今年大牌扎堆，最终获奖名单也算是比较有说服力，争议什么的基本就没了（要说争议可能主要在入围阶段了）。最终蔡依林的《Pleasure》和张震岳的《跟着感觉走》成为大赢家，它们各拿下了 3 个奖。

其中《Pleasure》拿了分量最重的“年度专辑奖”（“年度专辑奖”不是一定要在四种语言的最佳专辑里产生），蔡依林拿了“最佳华语女歌手奖”，再加个技术类的“最佳演唱录音专辑奖”，而《跟着感觉走》获得了“最佳华语专辑奖”，张震岳则拿了“最佳作曲人奖”和“最佳华语男歌手奖”。

裘德就可惜一点了，他只拿了“最佳编曲人奖”。倒是萧煌奇凭借《做一个惜情软心的人》有 4 项入围，最终拿下了“最佳台语专辑奖”和“最佳台语男歌手奖”。

除此之外，A-Lin 的《幸福在歌唱》获得了“年度歌曲奖”，落日飞车凭借《QUIT QUIETLY》时隔 5 年再次获得“最佳乐团奖”（入围的还有 icyball 冰球乐团、老王乐队、甜约翰、告五人、Tizzy Bac 等，竞争挺激烈），单依纯的《纯妹妹》有 5 项入围，最后由常石磊获得了“最佳专辑制作人奖”。

有获奖的就有遗憾的，像是入围名单里被看好的洪佩瑜的《开》、郑宜农的《圆缺》、春面乐队的《下回上去》都是 3 项入围，但最终一无所获。

而这届台湾金曲奖在入围阶段则是有明显的质疑声，《恒星不忘 Forever Forever》没入围，林宥嘉、陶喆和曾沛慈更是全部落榜，在粉丝们看来，他们不至于一项入围都拿不到。这届评审团主席黄韵玲对此的解释又打官腔，说林宥嘉成长了非常多，但“回归到评审机制，会有不同的声音和判别”，说陶喆“曾经太辉煌，大家对他的期待值更好”……可能粉丝和当事人听了会更生气吧。

也恰恰就在这次颁奖典礼的同一晚，林宥嘉在广州开始了全新的《超级管家》世界巡演的第一站，曾沛慈则拿下了《乘风 2026》（浪姐 7）的总冠军。这些仿佛是在对台湾金曲奖的回应，或许也是最好的安排了。

items.title: 每周鞋报：匡威 Chuck 70 X 重磅亮相，几个联名鞋款都各有看点
items.content_text:
过去一周世界杯渐入佳境，其它领域的鞋款也在按部就班的推陈出新。明星在传播里占了更多比重，鞋圈这边，PUMA 在 6 月 29 日发布了由大中华区品牌代言人张凌赫出镜的大片，当中张凌赫穿上了刚在 6 月初发布的无碳板跑鞋 Deviate Pure NITRO 的深色款，还搭了一套全新速感系列服装。粉丝们可以传播起来了。

另一边，匡威也在 6 月 29 日官宣签了 aespa 成员刘知珉（Karina），她穿着匡威最新的 Chuck 70 X 出镜了大片。匡威这两年业绩压力不小，这次鞋款焕新加签明星，也是大手笔了，品牌方面对此肯定抱有了很高的期待。

匡威 Chuck 70 X

说到匡威，这段时间鞋圈最大的新闻可能就是匡威 Chuck 70 的升级了。匡威已经好几次希望为这个能追溯到上百年历史的鞋款做改款，但效果都很一般，比如 2015 年的 Chuck Taylor All Star II，后来就不了了之了，2020 年的 Chuck Taylor All Star CX 也推了一波，现在也不提了。

关键它们都不是不好穿，而恰恰是很好穿，但还是卖不过最经典的那一款，仿佛是有种魔力。

而这次 Chuck 70 X 又是奔着辞旧迎新去的，在延续经典设计语言的同时，新款着重加强了工艺和舒适度，它的鞋头与鞋带孔有双星镌刻设计，鞋侧皮质标识、做旧质感的橡胶鞋头等都很细致，而针对亚洲人脚型做的全新鞋楦（更宽一些）、超临界发泡技术的 Amped“反重力”鞋垫以及整体轻量化处理，希望带来更轻盈舒适的全天候穿着体验。

它有高帮和低帮可选，定价分别是 649 和 599 元（相比经典款也是贵了不少），有多种配色，目前已经在匡威的官方小程序上首发。虽说是“为亚洲消费者打造”，但后面它会陆续进入更多国际市场。

On x POST ARCHIVE FACTION (PAF) Current Form 4.0 系列

6 月 23 日，On 昂跑和长期合作伙伴 POST ARCHIVE FACTION (PAF) 又带来了新的联动成果，这次是 Current Form 4.0 系列。

系列的核心产品是 Cloudboom Volt PAF，它有白/风暴灰和余烬/鹅卵石两款配色。由双方联合设计的鞋款带来了叠层鞋面结合一体式包裹结构，并有编织和网眼材质的应用，在加强锁定性的同时也提升了透气性。此外它搭载了 Helion 泡棉中底，确保了缓震能力和能量反馈。

鞋款整体诠释了飞蛾“蜕变”意象，这一主题也体现在了导演 Theodor Guelat 执导的视觉影片和摄影师 Zachary Handley 掌镜的大片里。

同时整个系列还包括了夹克、背心、短裤、T 恤、腰包、帽子和袜子等多款机能性单品，它们同样专为跑步运动打造，一整套装备都有了。

整个系列已经从 6 月 25 日开始发售，可以留意 On 线下门店和指定零售渠道。

New Balance X Miu Miu with Coco Gauff 合作系列 530 SL Decò 皮革版

同样是长期伙伴，New Balance、Miu Miu 和可可·高芙（Coco Gauff）的关系也是相当长了，从当年的“天才少女”，到现在可可·高芙最高世界排名第二，已经拿了 11 个单打冠军，成长得相当不错。

6 月 23 日，这三方带来了新的合作系列，并同步发布了广告大片。系列下有运动内衣、百褶裙及外搭单品，它们采用科技弹力针织平纹面料打造，并有极简的廓形和剪裁方式，融合了经典网球着装和功能性。同时也有帽子和发带，它们都点缀了这次合作的海军蓝与红色相间的联名徽标。

系列下的鞋履是全新 Decò 皮革版 530 SL 网球运动鞋，它有着漂亮的上脚效果，采用的是非对称配色的编织鞋带，整体随性洒脱，同时也很好进行日常穿搭。

整个系列目前已经通过全球指定 Miu Miu 精品店以及品牌官网和小程序发售，其中鞋履的定价是 9750 元。

PUMA x KidSuper 内马尔专属定制 Future

世界杯正在进行中，内马尔场上表现先不说，场下看点还是非常多的，除了又买了百万美元的表，PUMA 和 KidSuper 还为内马尔带来了一款专属定制的 Future 足球鞋，设计上以凤凰为意象，致敬了内马尔重披巴西战袍的“王者归来”。

这款 Future 采用了内马尔亲自选的明黄色，同时加上了 KidSuper 手绘的凤凰图腾，在 Future 标志性的 3D 立体肌理衬托下显得更加生动。而在鞋垫位置，KidSuper 画了球场、家园和大力神杯的图样，这也成为内马尔人生轨迹的诠释。

作为实战球鞋，Future 有着全新升级的 FUZIONFIT 鞋面，局部 3D 抓地纹路搭配 GripControl Pro 科技，让每次触球都足够精准，它还有能支撑 360 度变向的 FLEXGILITY 大底，这也非常适配内马尔的球风。

这款专属定制 Future 也是零售的，它已经在 6 月 26 日通过 PUMA 官网和全球指定零售商发售。

KITH for BIRKENSTOCK 2026 夏季联名系列

6 月 25 日，BIRKENSTOCK 和 KITH 共同推出了 2026 夏季联名系列，延续了双方长期的合作。

这次系列主打 Amsterdam 包头鞋和 Zurich 包裹式凉鞋，它们基于经典廓形，并做了重新演绎。

前者采用优质麂皮与牛巴革鞋面，鞋身外侧点缀 Kith Script 压印纹样，同时搭载标志性软木乳胶鞋床加经典 EVA 外底，有沙色和黑色可选，后者则以满印 Kith Monogram 压印工艺的麂皮鞋面呈现，以“深井蓝”（Deep Well）搭配银色金属扣饰，鞋面有可调节双扣，同样搭配软木乳胶鞋床。

系列已经从 6 月 25 日开始在中国大陆地区发售，渠道包括官方微信小程序以及位于上海张园和成都太古里的线下概念店。

鬼塚虎 GYMNARINA 芭蕾鞋款

6 月 26 日，Onitsuka Tiger 鬼塚虎带来了全新系带式芭蕾鞋款 GYMNARINA，它基于经典芭蕾舞鞋的纤细鞋型，同时融入了 Mexico 66 的一些标志性细节，让鞋款更加实穿，也适合了更多场景。

GYMNARINA 的鞋面以柔软优质皮革打造，有褶皱弹力设计带来柔和贴合的上脚感受，鞋底也强调了稳定性加柔韧，即便长时间穿着也能舒适且活动自如。

同时 GYMNARINA 的鞋身用了交叉绑带设计，后跟有翻盖结构，还有品牌经典的虎爪纹元素，穿着时可选带金属鞋带头的扁平鞋带或者缎面系带，实现对风格的轻松切换。

目前 GYMNARINA 已经开始在鬼冢虎全国指定门店和官方线上商店发售，它有红/白、蓝/白、黑/白、银/白和玫瑰金/白共 5 种配色，定价是 1090 元。

items.title: 做了 50 年一线编辑工作，都筑响一在《圈外编辑》里分享了自己的思考与理念
items.content_text:
说到都筑响一可能国内的同学不会太了解，但看看他的履历可能很多人就恍然大悟了，都筑响一参与了早期《POPEYE》（《POPEYE》在 1976 年创刊，今年正在庆祝 50 岁生日）、《BRUTUS》这些杂志的编辑工作，但有意思的是他一直不是固定职员，而始终保持了自由编辑的身份。

以国内的情况来说自由撰稿人会多一点，自由编辑其实很少，而日本的出版界也的确给都筑响一创造了一个独特的环境，他以自由记者的身份进行各种采访，push 了各个杂志带来特别策划，或者因为自己想做的选题实在太多，很多时候就自己做了，成为了单行本直接出版。

在这本《圈外编辑》里，都筑响一分享了自己从业以来的工作经历——1956 年生于东京的都筑响一今年已经 70 岁，但他还跑在第一线，其实以他的资历和身份，他早就可以成为一个机构的主编或者管理者，完全不需要自己再到处跑了，但这是他的选择，他也乐在其中。

都筑响一从 20 岁开始为刚创刊的《POPEYE》工作，到现在他的职业生涯已经长达半个世纪（不过这本书最早是 2015 年底在日本出版的，书里也提到“自由编辑一做就是 40 年”），50 年里他完成了拍摄上百个东京普通人狭小住处的《东京风格》，出版了搜寻日本和世界各地古怪景点的《珍奇日本纪行》和《珍奇世界纪行》系列，率先报道了一系列日本本土的嘻哈歌手，收集了死刑犯临刑前写下的诗句进行出版和做展……

很多即便放到现在都很可能不会被通过的选题，在都筑响一看来都没什么是不能做的，甚至那些“大家都做的选题”才没有再做的必要。抱持着这样的理念，都筑响一也形成了一套自己的方法论，在《圈外编辑》里，都筑响一从具体的经历提炼出了“养成自己的编辑观点”的方式，以及回答了“你为谁做书”、“编辑能做什么”这些问题。

当然都筑响一的很多观点还是相当犀利的，像是“杀死出版的正是它的创造者——我们这些编辑”这样的话足够引起我们更多的思考。但是当下这个时代相比 50 年前是更好还是更糟糕了呢，这个答案或许不一定，但既然会想看这本书，应该都是关注者、爱好者乃至从业者，是什么让我们最初心潮澎湃地参与到这份工作中，是什么让我们成就感满满甚至想起来都会挺胸抬头……在看《圈外编辑》时，我老会想到这些。

购买：天猫

items.title: 今日消费资讯：林里在广州开启百店同庆活动、DIOR 2027 夏季男装系列发布秀在巴黎举行
items.content_text:
《奥德赛》内地定档 8 月 14 日

6 月 26 日，环球影业宣布《奥德赛》（The Odyssey）内地定档 8 月 14 日上映。

这部改编自同名荷马史诗的影片由克里斯托弗·诺兰执导，马特·达蒙、汤姆·霍兰德、安妮·海瑟薇、罗伯特·帕丁森、查理兹·塞隆、赞达亚、艾利奥特·佩吉、乔·博恩瑟等出演。影片此前已定档 7 月 17 日在北美院线上映。

林里在广州开启百店同庆活动

6 月 26 日，林里 LINLEE 在广州区域超过 130 家门店开启“百店同舟，越饮越爽”主题同庆活动，活动将持续到 6 月 30 日。

这次有“大湾鸡鸭”的回归，同时有多个折扣福利同步进行。其中 6 月 26 - 28 日广州全城门店到店就有“霸王杯买一送一”专属福利（白葡萄冰柠茶霸王杯除外），而在 6 月 29 - 30 日期间，顾客加入社群就能领取无门槛“买一送一券”。此外整个活动期间通过林里官方小程序点餐，单笔满 15 元就能解锁“百店齐庆大转盘”抽奖。

% ARABICA 阿莱茵 Al Jimi Mall 店开业

5 月 17 日，% ARABICA 在阿联酋阿莱茵（Al Ain）的 Al Jimi Mall 购物中心开出新店，店铺由奥地利建筑工作室 Precht 操刀，这次并没有用 Precht 标志性的“售货亭”（kiosk），而是以阿莱茵“沙漠绿洲”的城市风貌为灵感，带来了由天然木质结构和白色元素组成的开放式休憩空间。

这是 % ARABICA 在阿莱茵的第 2 家门店，全球 242 号店。

DIOR 2027 夏季男装系列发布秀在巴黎举行

北京时间 6 月 24 日下午 3 点 15 分，DIOR 2027 夏季男装系列发布秀在巴黎尼西姆·德·卡蒙多博物馆（Musée Nissim de Camondo）举行，本季 Jonathan Anderson 着眼着装规范、工艺技法与廓形，并将这些元素以更加松弛的方式进行呈现，其中能看到不同时期的设计，但在新的时期以全新视角进行了重塑。

红杉中国控股 Golden Goose 交易已完成

6 月 24 日，Golden Goose 确认去年 12 月 20 日红杉中国宣布的对集团多数股权的收购交易已经完成，同时淡马锡及其全资拥有的资产管理公司淡明资本也已完成作为少数股权股东的投资。

也同之前报道的一样，交易完成后，Silvio Campara 将继续担任 CEO，与现有领导团队一起推动 Golden Goose 发展，而 2024 年 4 月开始担任董事会非执行董事的 Marco Bizzarri（之前 GUCCI 的总裁兼 CEO）从即日起出任非执行董事会主席。

法拉利 Luce 中国市场定价 398.8 万元起

6 月 26 日，法拉利在上海为旗下首款纯电车 Luce 举行了中国发布会，这也是 Luce 的亚洲首秀。

活动上宣布了 Luce 在中国市场的起售价是 398.8 万元，这也让中国大陆成为 Luce 售价最便宜的市场之一（参考欧洲市场是 55 万欧元，约合人民币 425 万元）。

items.content_text: 在理論物理學中，AdS/CFT對偶是兩種物理理論間的假想聯繫。對偶的一邊是共形場論，是量子場論的一種，量子場論中還包括與描述基本粒子的楊-米爾斯理論相近的其他理論。而對偶的另一邊則是反德西特空間（AdS），是用於量子重力理論的空間，以弦理論或M理論表述。

items.content_text:
GoldenDict-ng 是一款开源、功能全面、多格式的字典软件，可以在查询一个单词的时候从多本词典中显示结果。

支持包括 MDict、StarDict、DSL、Zim/Kiwix 等常见的离线字典格式 和 Wiktionary、DictD、LinguaLibre 等在线的资源。并且可以添加任意的网站和程序来当作字典的来源。

GoldenDict-ng 是由国人从原版 GoldenDict 分支出来的，相比原版：

  • 支持最新版的 Qt6，用 QtWebEngine 取代不再维护的 QtWebKit
  • 处理了大量原版中多年没有解决的 …

items.title: IMF Downgrades Global Growth Forecast Second Time In A Row
items.content_text:
IMF Downgrades Global Growth Forecast Second Time In A Row

The IMF downgraded global growth prospects for the second time this year, saying it expects the global economy to grow by just 3 percent in 2026.

As Statista's Katharina Buchholz reports, in January, this projection had still stood at 3.3 percent. While the downgrade is slight, it still conveys the multiple risks to the global economy currently present. As shocks from the Iran war persist, driving up the price of energy and other traded goods, disinflation has stalled and financial markets continue to be at risk of negative reactions.

The IMF saw a positive aspect in the global AI boom, creating an increase in demand for related technologies.

You will find more infographics at Statista

Two countries upgraded since the last forecast were China and the UK, the latter one on a very low level, however. Other countries where economic growth is paper-thin and decreasing are France, Germany and Japan. All three are expected to grow by only 0.6–0.7 percent each this year. This number was as low as 0.9 percent for the Euro Area and 1.1 percent for Canada, giving rise to some doubts around the economic prospects of developed countries in general. The IMF meanwhile said the global economy weathered the current shocks "better than feared".

The organization also said that global first-quarter growth in 2026 turned out better than expected at an annualized 3.0 percent quarter-over-quarter, slightly above forecast. According to the IMF, the rise in renewable energy use was making economies less vulnerable to elevated energy prices which are currently an issue. The AI boom also helped some countries and territories to achieve better economic growth numbers, but this was mostly limited to Taiwan, South Korea, Thailand and Malaysia. China could also grow more than expected on the back of public investments and a high-tech manufacturing surge. Much of the rest of the world, however, pretty much suffered the negative effects of the current crisis without many upsides.

The IMF concludes that risks to the world economy were more balanced than in April, but still pointed in a negative direction as both peace in the Middle East and gains from the AI boom remain fragile. It also cautions that trade tensions could resurface as a result of war-induced shortages, which would put an additional damper on the economy.

items.title: Record High 53% Of Gang Rape Suspects Were Foreigners In 2025 In Germany
items.content_text:
Record High 53% Of Gang Rape Suspects Were Foreigners In 2025 In Germany

Via Remix News,

The share of foreigners involved in gang rapes hit a record high in 2025, reaching 53 percent. A total of 751 victims were gang-raped in the country. The data comes from a response by the German federal government to a parliamentary request by the Alternative for Germany (AfD).

According to the statistics, 53 percent of the suspects — a total of 574 — did not have German citizenship in gang rape cases. Broken down by nationality, 110 suspects came from Syria, 64 from Afghanistan, 46 from Iraq, 44 from Turkey, and the rest from other

ountries, Focus Online reported.

Among the victims, 80 percent were German citizens.

While the report discloses that 509 suspects came from Germany, data about a possible migration background among German citizens was not recorded separately. Previous studies have shown that when the first names of gang rape suspects are analyzed, a total of 75 percent of gang rapes are committed by individuals with a foreign first name.

The high number of foreigners involved in gang rape cases comes at a time when more and more foreigners have been naturalized as German citizens. Millions of migrants also have dual citizenship and whenever they rape, murder or steal, their crimes are recorded as “German” in the federal crime statistics.

🇩🇪Germany

2 Syrians have been convicted for taking turns gang raping a 27-year-old unconscious woman in Düsseldorf on top of the hood of a car, along with a third suspect who remains on the run from police.

At first, Saad A. (34) said he was "ashamed" to have a woman as his… pic.twitter.com/mRHFHsUHjw

— Remix News & Views (@RMXnews) June 22, 2026

The AfD has demanded that the interior ministry begin breaking down crime statistics not only by citizenship status but also by migration background, which would enable German authorities to determine integration success and crime rates among German citizens with a foreign background.

“Although the issue has been on the political agenda for years, there is clearly a lack of effective political and legal measures to prevent these crimes,” AfD politician Stephan Brandner told WELT.

He also responded to the fact that 72 percent of all solved cases involve a suspect who was already known to the police.

“This demonstrates a blatant failure of the judiciary, security authorities and politics. This requires consistent prosecution, faster procedures, harsher sanctions and – in the case of foreign perpetrators – consistent termination of residence. Only in this way can women be effectively protected from such acts,” Brandner stated.

During a session in the Bundestag earlier this month, Alternative for Germany (AfD) leader Alice Weidel described a case from Nuremberg in which migrants allegedly subjugated underage girls with drugs and forced them into prostitution. Her speech was met with loud interjections in the plenary session, including laughter. The AfD chairwoman then detailed the case at the Nuremberg Central Station, where young men from Syria, Iraq, Pakistan and North African countries are alleged to have driven girls between the ages of 13 and 18 from precarious circumstances into drug addiction in order to force them into prostitution.

items.title: The Economics Of The Surveillance State
items.content_text:
The Economics Of The Surveillance State

Authored by  John Wilder,

“That was a Beria operation in Stalin’s time.  It was deactivated twenty years ago.”

– The Living Daylights

How did KGB agents commit suicide?  Two shots to the back of the head.  (all photo content as-found)

Remember Lavrentiy Beria’s cheerful advice:  “Show me the man, and I will find the crime”?  Back in the Soviet Union they had so many laws on the books that everybody broke at least one before lunch, I mean, when lunch was available.  And if they didn’t, they could make up something.  Beria just needed enough spies and informants to spot the right violation.

Beria would have loved modern America.  We’ve upgraded his whole operation with better cameras, faster computers, and added actual profit margins.

Let’s start with Flock™ cameras.

Flock Safety© cameras now line roads from coast to coast.  More than 100,000 of the little snitches sit on poles in ditches scanning license plates 24/7 and however many metric hours in a metric day and metric days in a metric week.  The cameras rolled out one quiet law enforcement contract at a time until the whole country is now blanketed.

Not everyone who comes into your life is your friend.  Some are just surveillance cameras. (btw, she was innocent, but the police didn’t apologize)

Maps of the cameras exist online, but those rely on humans, and it shows only three of the eight within five miles of my house in Modern Mayberry.  I could plot an avoidance route if I had nothing better to do than play spy versus spy on my commute, or build a detector like Benn Jordan did.

Most of us have jobs and families instead.  But, hey, we’ve funded a system so that every time you get on the road, you’re creating a record that will last as long as they have storage.  And cops can now use this to stalk their ex-wives, so it’s a double win, right?

How did the farmer stalk his ex?  He tractor.

Next up?

Ring™ doorbells joined the neighborhood watch program without asking their “owner’s” permission.  When several co-eds were murdered in Idaho a couple of years ago, investigators pulled Ring© footage to track a suspect’s car.  A subpoena moves quicker than a polite request and never waits for the doorbell to be answered, so they got all the data that they needed to catch the guy.  I’m okay with catching murderers, but how many people will be caught in fishing dragnets for being in the wrong place at the wrong time?

Where exactly are you going at 2 a.m., citizen?

Laptops aren’t safe, either.

A hacker got grabbed in Finland on his way out of the country.  Prosecutors used the connection with Microsoft’s© handy Global Device Identifier™ to identify him.  One persistent number tied his computer to all the mischief.  Microsoft® handed over the records after the usual court paperwork and a feeble, “oh, stop . . . customer privacy . . . .”  My operating system apparently keeps better tabs on me than my own mother, but at least Ma Wilder has the excuse of being dead.

I wonder if my FBI agent likes the jokes I make?

Then there is Windows Recall© on the fancy new Copilot™ machines.  It snaps pictures of your screen every few seconds while you work and builds a searchable scrapbook of everything you looked at.  Local storage only

They promise.  Pinky swear, even.

Still feels like my laptop decided to start a scrapbooking hobby without telling me first.

Besides, my ISP already knows every site you visit and how long you lingered.  Edward Snowden spilled the beans years ago on the big programs that pulled data straight from the servers of Microsoft™, Google®, Apple©, Facebook™ and the Rest®.  Fiber-optic taps caught traffic in bulk, Then three-letter outfits and tech companies worked hand in glove.

The result is giant databases full of regular people doing regular things.  But don’t worry!  If you’ve been good, you’re fine.  And if you’re Hillary Clinton or Jeff Epstein, all the data will be lost.

Big Tech loves this data game because it prints money for them.  They track my habits down to the weirdest details (really, kittens eating salami?) and sell the profiles to insurers, advertisers, and anyone else with a checkbook.

My patterns become their product.  They turn my life into a spreadsheet and then mark it up like a used-car dealer who knows you really need that transmission fixed today.

Speaking of cars, they’re getting chatty, too.

Modern ones log every trip, every hard brake, every late-night drive.  Some already phone home to the manufacturer and won’t work unless the software license is up to date.  Insurance companies will pay good money for a direct feed on how I actually drive instead of guessing from your age and ZIP code.

Soon enough, the car might call the cops if it thinks I had one too many.  My pickup turns into the world’s most expensive designated snitch.

Hopefully, during the 4th of July holiday you didn’t get distracted and miss the big picture:  The British blew a 13 colony lead.

Ninety-nine percent of us carry cell phones that never stop reporting.  Every search, every video, every song gets logged.  Cops have started treating a phone left at home like suspicious behavior (I’m not making this up).  The little rectangle in your pocket is the most reliable witness I never hired.

Big companies with this much reach do have a kryptonite®:  governments.  They do exactly what the government asks.  They bent over backwards to limit talk about COVID and elections under the last administration.  Books and posts that wandered off the approved script vanished from platforms:  I know, I made a COVID joke on a podcast and it was sent to podcast jail.

The same tools will work just as well for whoever sits in the big chair next.  They already proved they can move fast when someone important asks nicely.

Harvey Silverglate spelled this out in his book Three Felonies a Day.  Federal law has grown so broad and fuzzy that a decent prosecutor can usually find something to charge anyone with.  Normal life now sits inside a minefield of possible violations.  Add constant surveillance and the minefield gets floodlights, motion sensors, and a searchable menu.

Stalin put a ? after the name of every traitor:  they question Marx.

The Code of Federal Regulations stretches to roughly 190,000 pages or almost the number of words in a GloboLeftist meme. items.title: Which States Produce The Most Food In America?
items.content_text:
Which States Produce The Most Food In America?

From California’s fruit and vegetable farms to the Midwest’s vast corn and soybean fields, agriculture looks very different across the United States.

Using the latest data from the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA), this graphic, via Visual Capitalist's Dorothy Neufeld, ranks every state by its agricultural production value in 2024.

America’s Largest Agricultural Economies

The table below shows each state’s agricultural production value in 2024.

Together, the top 10 states account for well over half of America’s agricultural production value. Geography, climate, water availability, and decades of specialization have helped create distinct regional farming economies across the country.

California Remains America’s Agricultural Giant

California generated $67.4 billion in agricultural production value in 2024, nearly twice as much as any other state.

Its combination of specialty crops, fruits, vegetables, nuts, dairy, and favorable growing conditions allows it to produce more agricultural value than any other U.S. state despite accounting for only a small share of the nation’s farmland.

Texas, another large state by both population and land area, ranks third nationally, generating $37.6 billion driven largely by cattle production.

The Midwest Is America’s Food Engine

While California tops the rankings individually, the Midwest dominates collectively.

The region accounts for 44% of U.S. agricultural production value, powered by states including Iowa, Nebraska, Minnesota, Indiana, and Illinois. Taken together, these states produce over 60% of America’s corn volume.

Many Midwestern states also specialize in soybeans, livestock, and dairy, forming the backbone of both the U.S. food system and global agricultural exports. This makes the Midwest one of the world’s leading agricultural production corridors.

A Diverse Agricultural Economy

Agricultural strength varies widely by region. Western states generate high-value specialty crops, vineyards, and dairy, while Southern states are major producers of poultry, cotton, rice, and cattle. Although Northeastern agriculture is smaller by value, it remains an important source of dairy, produce, and regional food supply.

This regional specialization helps make the U.S. one of the world’s leading agricultural producers and food exporters, supplying both domestic consumers and global markets alike.

To learn more about this topic, check out this graphic on the states with the most farmland.

L3Harris has taken a significant step toward advancing next-generation propulsion technology for future offensive and defensive missions.

Full-Scale Test Of New Solid Fuel Ramjet Fuel Grain

L3Harris highlighted that the event marked the company's first full-scale test of a new solid fuel ramjet fuel grain specially formulated to significantly reduce the cost of fuel when compared to historical industry standards.

During the ground test, the team ignited and operated the system in a direct connect flight-representative environment, allowing engineers to evaluate performance across a large portion of the simulated flight envelope. Initial results showed propulsion levels were consistent with expectations for flight operation, giving the team valuable data as it continues to refine the design towards tactical missile system demonstration, according to a press release.

Disciplined Approach Marks An Essential Risk Reduction

This test event helps validate key performance characteristics as L3Harris accelerates towards flight testing, and this disciplined approach marks an essential risk reduction step in enabling solid fuel ramjet propulsion to help close a critical performance and cost gap for the U.S. military and allies.

"We are answering the Department of War's call for longer-reach, more capable, lower-cost propulsion that is producible at the scale needed," said Joel Warhurst, Director, Business Development, L3Harris.

As global defense requirements continue to evolve, advanced ramjet propulsion is expected to play a crucial role in future missile systems by providing higher sustained speeds, extended engagement ranges, and improved survivability against sophisticated air defense networks. California Ex-Police Official Tops State Payroll With $1.2 Million Payday

Former Redlands Police Deputy Chief Travis Martinez received nearly $1.2 million in wages in 2025, the highest reported compensation for any city employee in California, according to newly released data from the State Controller's Office and reporting by the New York Post.

Payroll records show Martinez collected $81,804 in regular pay, $890,467 in other compensation and $231,099 in lump-sum payments before retiring in April. The city also contributed roughly $55,900 toward his retirement and health benefits, bringing his total compensation package to about $1.26 million.

The State Controller's Office publishes annual payroll data for public employees, while public records compiled by Transparent California identified the employee as Martinez.

The Post writes that according to the Orange County Register, the unusually large payout stemmed from a settlement that resolved a lengthy dispute between Martinez and the city. He had been on paid administrative leave for about 18 months before retiring in April 2025. As part of the agreement, Martinez retired and dropped a legal claim against the city in exchange for a settlement reportedly worth about $872,000.

In a 2023 claim, Martinez alleged city officials retaliated against him after he reported what he described as misconduct within the police department. Among other allegations, he said he raised concerns about efforts to conceal evidence related to a fatal Metrolink train crash and reported claims of sexual misconduct involving then-Deputy Chief Mike Reiss to the FBI after concluding the matter was not being properly addressed internally.

Martinez remained on paid leave until his retirement. Separately, allegations against Reiss have resulted in multiple legal settlements for the city. Reiss retired in 2023 after being accused of grooming and sexually harassing several department employees, while former Police Chief Chris Catren retired days earlier, denying any connection to the controversy.

Over the past three years, Redlands has approved more than $3.3 million in settlements related to sexual harassment lawsuits involving Reiss. In his legal filing, Martinez described his 29-year career as exemplary and alleged he was repeatedly denied promotions because he refused to overlook misconduct within the department.

Anthropic and OpenAI are leading adoption among AI-native platforms, reinforcing the view that the enterprise chatbot and frontier-model battle is increasingly becoming a two-pony race.

items.title: DARPA's Chilling Pre-COVID Blueprint: Predict, Manufacture, & Deploy Pandemics On Demand
items.content_text:
DARPA's Chilling Pre-COVID Blueprint: Predict, Manufacture, & Deploy Pandemics On Demand

Authored by Jon Fleetwood, via Substack,

A sprawling, multi-institution effort for "predicting" future pathogen characteristics, developing vaccines "in advance of need," and building the very systems intended to validate those predictions.

The Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) spent the early 2010s constructing what may have been the most ambitious predictive vaccine-development infrastructure ever attempted: a sprawling, multi-institution effort designed to determine the future characteristics of purported pathogens before they emerged and ultimately use those predictions to develop drugs and vaccines before they were needed.

The program, known as PROPHECY—short for Pathogen Defeat—was announced in 2010 under Broad Agency Announcement DARPA-BAA-10-93 and was managed by DARPA’s Defense Sciences Office.

DARPA itself described the vaccine-centric purpose of the program unambiguously.

According to the agency: “The Prophecy (Pathogen Defeat) program will explore the evolution of viruses in the hopes of predicting viral mutations and ultimately developing drugs and vaccines in advance of need.”

The effort was not limited to coronaviruses, influenza, or any other single disease category.

DARPA repeatedly stated that the goal was understanding: “the natural evolution of any virus.”

The result was a massive architecture that brought together machine learning researchers, statisticians, bioinformaticians, computational biologists, laboratory scientists, surveillance specialists, universities, contractors, and national laboratories into a single “predictive” framework.

Yesterday, this website reported that DARPA’s PROPHECY program expanded into the laboratory of coronavirus researcher Ralph Baric years before the COVID-19 pandemic and nearly a decade before the DARPA/DEFUSE proposal documented all three defining structural features of the SARS-CoV-2 spike protein prior to the outbreak.

DARPA Wanted to Turn Vaccine Development from Reactive to Predictive

DARPA openly believed that existing vaccine development operated backwards.

The agency described the modern pharmaceutical model as: “observational and reactive.”

PROPHECY was intended to replace that model with one that was: “predictive and preemptive.”

Rather than waiting for future purported disease threats to appear before beginning the process of characterization and countermeasure development, DARPA sought systems capable of determining the characteristics of future pathogen populations in advance.

Everything in PROPHECY flowed from that objective.

Building the Blueprint Before the Pathogen

DARPA’s ambitions extended far beyond outbreak forecasting.

The agency stated: “DARPA seeks to achieve the ability to successfully predict the natural evolution of any virus, via platforms and algorithms which are capable of monitoring rare advantageous viral events…”

The program sought systems capable of determining:

  • future mutations,
  • future reassortments,
  • future genetic events,
  • the order in which mutations would emerge,
  • genotype-to-phenotype relationships,
  • and ultimately the characteristics of future pathogen populations.

DARPA acknowledged: “there is at present no reliable capability to predict viral reassortment or mutations responsible for the emergence of new viral strains.”

Its proposed solution was: “An investigative platform to predict mutations and possibly reassortments in advance of their occurrence.”

The agency further explained that PROPHECY sought: “predictive algorithms of viral evolution that are informed and validated experimentally using high throughput biological platforms…” and: “the integration of a viral evolution platform with an algorithm that predicts mutations which confer an evolutionary advantage to the viral population.”

Among the formal requirements of the program was the ability to: “reproducibly predict the genomic, proteomic, and/or functional attributes of the final viral population.”

DARPA also sought to determine: “the rate and order of mutation acquisition” as well as: “the correlation of genotype to phenotype.”

The objective was not merely individual mutations.

It was the endpoint population itself.

Prediction Was Only the First Layer

PROPHECY was never designed to stop at prediction.

DARPA required participants to construct what it called: “biological validation systems” and repeatedly emphasized: “testing and validation of the system and algorithm.”

The BAA instructed performers to: “Perform a ‘real world’ test of the predictive algorithm and biological validation system…”

The purpose of that exercise was to determine whether researchers could: “reproducibly predict the genomic, proteomic, and/or functional attributes of the ending viral population.”

DARPA further instructed participants to: “develop a research strategy and solicit collaborations from partners” that would assist in: “applying their predictive methodology to surveillance data from the real world.”

The architecture described by PROPHECY therefore extended beyond prediction alone.

The program sought to construct systems capable not only of generating future pathogen blueprints, but also of attempting to validate those predictions experimentally and through subsequent observational frameworks.

Bottom Line

Amid COVID-19 debates, public attention has focused on later programs such as DEFUSE, ADEPT, pandemic mRNA platforms, and Operation Warp Speed.

But PROPHECY confirms that by 2010, DARPA was openly attempting to build a generalized predictive infrastructure capable of deciding the future characteristics of purported pathogens, using those predictions to enable drugs and vaccines in advance, and constructing systems intended to validate those predictions experimentally and through later observational frameworks.

Most importantly, the effort was never intended for a single disease.

PROPHECY sought to build this capability for: “any virus.”

Whether viewed as predictive biodefense, anticipatory genomics, preemptive countermeasure development, or something else, the architecture described by DARPA followed a remarkably consistent sequence:

  • vaccines as the objective;
  • future pathogen blueprints as the enabling technology;
  • “validation” systems as the final layer.

That architecture may ultimately prove to be one of the most consequential and least understood developments in the history of modern biodefense research.

DHS Deports Convicted Child Rapist Gov. Tim Walz Pardoned

The Department of Homeland Security deported Tou Lue Vang on Friday, the Laotian national Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz pardoned last month in an effort to keep him in the country.

Vang, 42, entered the United States illegally and built a life in Minnesota that included, by his own admission, sexually abusing a 10-year-old girl. He pleaded guilty in 2006 to first-degree criminal sexual conduct after admitting he abused the girl over four years, starting in 2002. When police arrested him in 2005, he offered no denial. Instead, he told investigators that marrying and having sex with girls as young as 12 was a cultural practice.

The Department of Homeland Security said Vang also offered his victim $10 to stay quiet while the abuse continued.

By pleading guilty, Vang avoided prison, but lost legal status. A judge issued him a final removal order in October 2006, and under any normal enforcement regime, that would have been the end of the story. Instead, Vang stayed in the country for nearly two decades, until Trump administration agents caught up with him last year through Operation Metro Surge, a Minnesota-based immigration enforcement effort.

Records show Vang applied for a pardon in July 2025, anticipating his inevitable deportation. Walz granted it through the state's three-member pardon board, which also includes Attorney General Keith Ellison and Minnesota Chief Justice Natalie Hudson. items.title: The Real Grid Crisis Is A State Policy Problem Dressed Up As A Market Failure
items.content_text:
The Real Grid Crisis Is A State Policy Problem Dressed Up As A Market Failure

Authored by Todd Snitchler via RealClearEnergy,

There's a critique of PJM making the rounds: PJM - the largest grid operator in the United States - is too big. There are too many state interests at play, and PJM doesn't have the ability to function cohesively or quickly enough. FERC even scheduled a governance technical conference this month to examine whether PJM's stakeholder structure can move fast enough to respond to demand. The reality is that policy disagreements at the state level are dressed up as a procedural defect with the grid, opening the way for critics to point their reforms at the wrong target.

Disagreements at the state level are just what you'd expect, pitting those that generate enough power to export against those that depend on imports. Pennsylvania is PJM's energy workhorse, shipping out roughly a quarter of everything it generates. Illinois, West Virginia, and Michigan also produce more than they consume. The others - Virginia, Maryland, New Jersey, and Delaware - are net importers, and increasingly so as data centers expand across their footprints.

Exporters like Pennsylvania that are rich in nuclear, gas, and coal generation have fundamentally different interests in capacity pricing and transmission cost allocation from an importer state, which has restricted natural gas development, leaned hard into renewables, or joined an ambitious emission reduction program. When Virginia pulls in more expensive power from its neighbors, or when Maryland absorbs double-digit rate hikes, that isn't a governance failure - it's the market doing its job by revealing the cost of divergent state policy preferences (and thus resource access).

These state policy preferences are then lobbed at the market and its participants to respond to, whether by prematurely retiring generation, relying on tax subsidies, or simply building generation that is more expensive per megawatt when compared against traditional baseload fuels.

PJM is actively working to continue the evolution of the market to meet the demand of today and the future. It has cleared more than 60% of its interconnection backlog under a reformed study process and opened a new study cycle this spring in partnership with Google to apply AI to speed up the review process. A separate PJM program, the Reliability Resource Initiative, pulled in more than 11,000 MW of new projects that could come online quickly. PJM has also adjusted its review processes to allow more wind, solar, and storage to compete directly in the capacity auction. It's even accepted a price collar through 2030, demonstrating that it is willing to make short-term adjustments in response to concerns by state executives.

More than 46,000 MW of approved projects - over a quarter of PJM's existing capacity - already hold the right to build but are unable to move forward. Some 37,000 MW of PJM-approved generation can't even break ground at all because of state and local permitting fights. At the same time, state policy mandates have pushed working plants into early retirement, further tightening supply from the other end. The same governors demanding faster action are often the ones holding the permits and slow-walking the buildout of energy infrastructure while forcing closures of dispatchable power.

PJM is not too big. It has demonstrated time and again that it can run a competitive power market and ensure the reliable transportation of power across 13 very varied states and the District of Columbia. It's been successfully doing this for more than 30 years, delivering $5 billion in savings annually to customers, just as it was designed to do. It's accelerated the queue and kept the lights on. What the market cannot do is permit projects or draft legislation. States must recognize their role in restricting the full benefits of the market.

Asking PJM to continue navigating these policy issues in the same manner - trying to respond to all of them - is a recipe for disaster. The states are absolutely responsible for chucking icebergs into the path of this ship, and if it goes down, they'll have themselves to blame for the aftermath.

Todd Snitchler is President and CEO of the Electric Power Supply Association (EPSA).

items.title: China Bans Helium Exports As Qatar Outage Deepens Global Supply Squeeze
items.content_text:
China Bans Helium Exports As Qatar Outage Deepens Global Supply Squeeze

China has abruptly banned helium exports, a key component in semiconductors, which adds yet another serious constraint to a global market already reeling from the loss of production in Qatar.

In a two-sentence Friday announcement, China's Ministry of Commerce and General Administration of Customs said helium covered by customs code 2804290010 was subject to a temporary prohibition on exports, effective immediately. The agencies cited China's Foreign Trade Law but provided no explanation, expiration date, transition period or exemptions. Any future adjustments, they said, would be announced separately. See the official Chinese government announcement.

The decision is more restrictive than an export-licensing requirement. It appears to prevent covered shipments to all foreign destinations, regardless of buyer or intended use. The announcement does not explain how customs officials will treat previously signed contracts, cargo awaiting departure or helium originally imported into China and subsequently repackaged for re-export.

Nor does it carve out exceptions for hospitals, scientific laboratories, semiconductor manufacturers or humanitarian users.

The physical volume removed from the international market may be relatively small. China accounted for an average of 5 percent of U.S. helium imports between 2021 and 2024, compared with 47 percent from Canada, 28 percent from Qatar and 10 percent from Algeria, according to the U.S. Geological Survey's 2026 helium commodity summary - but the significance of the move lies in its timing.

China produces only a fraction of the helium it consumes and imports roughly 85 percent or more of its requirements, according to reporting by Reuters, with the Associated Press places China's domestic production at no more than ~ 15 percent of its needs. This suggests the ban is principally an effort to conserve helium for domestic industry rather than a measure capable, by itself, of depriving foreign buyers of large quantities. It also implies that Beijing expects the present shortage to persist.

Chinese companies have increasingly acted as intermediaries - importing some Russian helium and re-exporting volumes to overseas markets, including Europe. The ban could therefore remove more internationally traded material than China's domestic production figures alone would suggest.

Qatar Shock Ripples Through A Concentrated Market

The global helium market was already under severe pressure before China's announcement. Helium is generally recovered as a byproduct of natural-gas processing. When a large gas complex stops operating, helium production cannot simply continue independently. That vulnerability became evident after attacks forced QatarEnergy to stop production of liquefied natural gas and associated products at its Ras Laffan complex - causing them to subsequently declared force-majeure on affected contracts. 

Further missile attacks damaged LNG Trains 4 and 6. QatarEnergy said the damaged facilities could take between three and five years to repair and estimated that the attacks had removed 17 percent of Qatar's LNG export capacity. See the company's statement on the damage and repair timetable.

Qatar produced an estimated 63 million cubic meters of helium in 2025, close to one-third of estimated world production, according to the USGS. A disruption there is therefore a worldwide rather than regional problem.

Helium prices reacted quickly. Spot prices doubled after the Middle East conflict began, according to industry participants interviewed by Reuters. Some market specialists warned that an extended disruption could push prices toward levels last seen during previous severe shortages.

The problem is compounded by the peculiar logistics of the helium trade. Liquid helium must remain at extraordinarily low temperatures and gradually evaporates during transportation. One industry executive told Reuters that suppliers effectively have about 45 days to move liquefied helium to the end user.

Unlike oil, helium lacks a large and transparent spot market. Most volumes are sold under private, long-term contracts, making real-time prices difficult to observe. Supply stress often emerges through customer allocations, surcharges and force-majeure notices rather than through a widely quoted futures contract.

China's exposure to Qatar is not accidental. In February 2025, QatarEnergy signed a 20-year agreement to deliver 100 million cubic feet of high-purity helium annually to China. It was the first direct, long-term helium supply agreement between Qatar and a Chinese buyer. 

The new ban therefore raises an important question: Is China merely stopping helium produced domestically, or is it also preventing imported Qatari, Russian and other foreign-origin helium from being resold abroad?

items.title: Without Subsidies, Is AI Unaffordable?
items.content_text:
Without Subsidies, Is AI Unaffordable?

Authored by Charles Hugh Smith via OfTwoMinds blog,

Let's pull all this into an undeniable conclusion: AI is based on massively subsidizing users' costs.

What's already abundantly clear but verboten to say as it would pop the bubble of AI valuations and triumphalism is that AI is unaffordable once the direct and indirect subsidies are withdrawn. Nothing that consumes this much electricity and requires such an immense scale of costly processing and memory capacity can be low-cost, never mind free.

The major AI platforms and vendors are subsidizing corporate and individual users in the hopes that they can achieve AI sector dominance --and the pricing power that comes with it--via the network effect, the dominance generated by having the majority of users bound by habit or dependence to your platform or tools.

This battle for network effect dominance is playing out in full view:

AI Giants Are Handing Out Tons of Free Computing Power to Grab Startup Share: (wsj.com) Pitched battle for business users comes as AI companies seek lasting streams of revenue.

Hans Ibarra, a founder building an AI-voice startup, has found himself on the receiving end of a big opportunity: Top artificial-intelligence companies such as OpenAI, Anthropic and others desperate to win his business are ramping up discounts.

Across Silicon Valley, startup founders like Ibarra are enjoying a wave of computing credits and fielding competing offers from AI-model makers racing to land new enterprise customers. Cursor, the AI-coding company bought by Elon Musk's SpaceX, offered a 75% discount through July 5.

"If I'm choosing between a really cheap Chinese model that I actually have to pay for, and a very expensive Anthropic model that I don't have to pay for, I'm going to pick the Anthropic model," Acker said. "I'm always going to pick the one for which I have free credits."

Meanwhile, back in the real world of costs, AI Costs More Than The People It Replaced (forbes.com)(via Tom D.)

It turns out that experienced human workers doing the work right in the first place is cheaper than having AI run a probability distribution process that needs vetting and corrections. And remember, AI isn't actually "intelligent," it's just a probability distribution using natural language.

As management guru Peter Drucker observed, enterprises don't have profits, they have costs. Purveyors of AI platforms and tools have costs, and so do their customers. Those costs are currently being funded by investors, who are in effect subsidizing the AI companies' "free" giveaways of horrendously costly "tokens" in a manic, desperate attempt to grab the brass ring of network effect dominance before their cash runs out.

This raises a question: Is this any way to run a railroad? In other words, is this actually a viable business model, burning billions of dollars in cash to lock in network effect dominance in a field that is rapidly obsoleting every iteration of an innately limited mode of computation? Is claiming that a probability distribution is "intelligent" in the same way humans are intelligent a viable business model when there is ample evidence this simply isn't true?

AI and human intelligence are drastically different--here's how (scientificamerican.com)

What happens when enterprises have to pay the unsubsidized costs of AI is they immediately curtail their AI spending because the customer-facing / financial benefits of AI are at best elusive and often negative. Peter Drucker was onto something that is currently being lost in the PR-propaganda push of those trying to cash in on the AI euphoria: enterprises don't have profits, they have costs, and the real-world costs of AI are extraordinarily high while the payoffs are ambiguous.

There are many other hidden subsidies within the AI machinery. There are corporate tax write-off subsidies, energy subsidies, tax credit subsidies for building data centers, and so on. If these were stripped out, what would the real unsubsidized costs of AI be? No one knows, but they would be higher than what's presented as the cost now.

Then there's the if it's legal, it's moral, and what's legal is for sale subsidy: AI is built on the systemic theft of copyrighted content. Last month alone, AI scrapers gorged on 246,000 pages from my Of Two Minds server, and hundreds of thousands of pages of my copyrighted works on my mirror site and other sites posting my work.

This is legal, but is it moral? Nobody asks such questions because the important thing is to avoid saddling AI users with the real costs. So if all those content creators get nothing--in effect, subsidizing both AI companies and the users of their AI platforms and tools--well, so what, because if it's legal, it's moral, and what's legal is for sale.

Well that's just peachy, but let's do a thought experiment where every creator of copyrighted work got paid for supplying AI with its database, and every user of AI had to pay us content creators. How about a penny a page / image / sound clip? so 246,000 pages per month (again, only a fraction of the total volume of my work that was scraped by AI companies for their "free" use in a single month) would be $2,460 a month paid to me by AI users benefiting directly from my copyrighted work. Wouldn't that be fair, i.e. moral?

Recall that US copyright law is explicit: all creative content is copyrighted upon completion, period.

How many current users of AI are willing to pay the full unsubsidized costs for their use of AI? We can safely say far fewer than are using the tools for "free" due to subsidies both direct and indirect.

Let's pull all this into an undeniable conclusion: AI is based on massively subsidizing users' costs. Once those subsidies end, what's left are costs, not profits. Play that any way you like, but massive subsidies are not sustainable, though they generate a temporary illusion of viability that can be exploited by those selling a fantasy of future profitability to credulous investors and enterprises.

Left unsaid is a lot of money is being gambled on the illusion that subsidies are sustainable. They're not. Enterprises don't have profits, they have costs.

items.title: Maine Dems Will Pick Platner Replacement At Rushed Convention This Month
items.content_text:
Maine Dems Will Pick Platner Replacement At Rushed Convention This Month

After their nominee for the 2026 Maine Senate race dropped out on Friday in the wake of sex assault allegations, Democrats will pick his successor at a convention on July 25th, the state party chair announced Friday afternoon. That's just two days before the deadline for making the change and securing a new nominees' place on the general election ballot. It's a tall order for one of the smallest state party organizations in the country, and Democrats haunted by the rushed 2024 insertion of deeply-flawed candidate Kamala Harris into Joe Biden's nominee slot are uneasy -- all the more so given how tight the race for Senate control could be.    

The crisis springs from previous nominee Graham Platner's withdrawal from the contest on Friday. He won the June 9th primary, but was done in by a Politico report in which a former girlfriend claimed a drunk Platner spontaneously showed up at her house and sexually assaulted her. Democrats who were already uneasy about Platner's profile -- which includes a history of philanderous sexts sent to multiple women, old Reddit posts self-identifying as a "communist," other posts calling cops "bastards," and a Nazi tattoo (though not a particularly obvious one). Setting aside the new rape allegation, all those black marks on his resume were public information before the primary election. 

“The voters of Maine, the Democratic primary voters of Maine, owe the rest of Mainers an apology.”

A thing that was actually said on CNN: pic.twitter.com/A8HOqYfWN7

— Ryan Grim (@ryangrim) July 10, 2026

The new Democratic nominee will take on five-term Republican Susan Collins, a shaky-voiced 73-year-old who's considered the GOP's most vulnerable incumbent. The Cook Political Report says the state's Senate race is one of four toss-ups this fall, along with the contests in Ohio, Michigan and Alaska. To wrest control of the Senate from the GOP, Democrats must flip four seats. 

 "The convention will be fair, representative and as transparent as possible," said Maine Democratic Party Chairman Charlie Dingman in a video statement. "In coordination with our legal counsel, we have put together a plan for this nominating convention that will allow us to choose a qualified candidate who has the energy, ideas and popular support to defeat Susan Collins." On its site, the party implied that a snap primary election was out of the question due to the tight time constraints. The Democratic State Committee "overwhelmingly" voted for the convention process after a long emergency meeting on Wednesday, according to PunchBowl's Ally Mutnick. 

Democrats searching for Platner’s replacement… pic.twitter.com/XqfKUyIrPe

— David Santa Carla 🦇 (@TheOnlyDSC) July 9, 2026

Held on the last Saturday of this month, the convention will comprise a whopping 601 delegates, 101 of whom will be members of the Democratic State Committee -- who are elected by voters -- and 500 delegates appointed by Maine's 16 counties. The proceedings will take place at the Cross Insurance Center in Bangor. "Voting will be conducted in rounds until one candidate reaches a majority," the party explained in an FAQ. "The five candidates receiving the highest number of votes in the first round will advance to the second round. Each subsequent round will eliminate the lowest vote-getter until one candidate is chosen." 

It appears there will be no party-organized debates or town halls before the convention. "The nominating convention will provide an opportunity for candidates to address delegates directly," said the party. "Candidates are encouraged to campaign in any way they see fit." 

A brokered convention, in late July in Maine, with control of the Senate potentially on the line — what more could the political press corps possibly ask for? pic.twitter.com/nwQa5nIbrS

— Alex Seitz-Wald (@aseitzwald) July 10, 2026

Democratic politicians who lost bids for other offices are pouring out the woodwork to take their shot at winning the nomination in a half-month sprint to the July 25th convention, including former public health official Nirav Shah, former Maine Senate president and logger Troy Jackson, and Maine secretary of state Shenna Bellows. All three of them sought the 2026 nomination for governor. Other hopefuls include former congressional staffer (for Katie Porter) Jordan Wood and social worker Paige Loud -- who both lost in the same congressional primary this year -- and Maine Beer Company co-founder Dan Kleban, who took an initial stab at the Senate nomination last year. 

If nothing else, this could make for some great political theater.
